name: Graham Platner
subject: the last chance
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Abdul for U
body:
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-ms-aes-20250930-1-ak?amount=5&refcode=em20250930-1025&refcode2=1025_251025_S7iMeI&akid=1025%2E251025%2ES7iMeI)
Peter,
I am about to ask if you can make a donation to help me defeat Susan Collins before our first FEC fundraising deadline at midnight. But before I do, please let me explain why this federally-mandated FEC deadline is so important.
After tonight, federal law requires our campaign against Susan Collins to pull together a report of how much we’ve raised and from how many donors. That report then becomes public – for everyone to see.
Reporters are going to dig into the report. Pundits will pore over every detail. But it’s not just them.
Susan Collins, her Super PACs, and special interests like AIPAC, Big Pharma, and Big Oil will all be looking for any sign of weakness in our campaign.
This is also the last chance for grassroots donors like you to show that you are still 100% behind me to defeat Susan Collins and flip Maine blue.
Our campaign has never been under a microscope more than we’re about to be now, so it’s critical we put forward a show of strength bigger than we’ve ever had.
That’s why we’ve set our biggest goal ever: **Raising another $500,000 before this first FEC deadline to show reporters, Susan Collins, and the entire Republican and Democratic establishment that we’re all-in to defeat Susan Collins in 2026 with a Democrat who will actually fight to protect our democracy.**
I’ll admit, it’s a big goal. But I’ve learned in life that that’s how important things are accomplished: By setting big goals and then working together to hit them. **We are so close to hitting this goal, and with your donation now, we’ll be able to show everyone the strength of our campaign and finally send Susan Collins packing in 2026.**
I’m not taking money from corporations or AIPAC. Instead, we’re building a campaign funded entirely by grassroots donors like you.
[**So please, will you split a donation now between our campaign and Abdul El-Sayed – before our first federally-mandated FEC deadline at midnight – to help us hit this huge goal and defeat Susan Collins?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-ms-aes-20250930-1-ak?amount=5&refcode=em20250930-1025&refcode2=1025_251025_S7iMeI&akid=1025%2E251025%2ES7iMeI)
**[Donate $5 ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-ms-aes-20250930-1-ak?amount=5&refcode=em20250930-1025&refcode2=1025_251025_S7iMeI&akid=1025%2E251025%2ES7iMeI)**
Let’s show everyone that we are 100% committed to finally giving Susan Collins the boot and flipping Maine blue to take back the Senate for Democrats.
We are going to win this race, but we can only do it together.
In solidarity,
Graham Platner

Marching, protesting, screaming in the streets was never going to be the end of it. Violence was always going to come..."

If breaking the law were the measure of success, Donald Trump would be the most “successful” president in the history of our country.
But what we’re seeing isn’t success at all — it’s a brazen, relentless assault on our Constitution and our communities.
Between Trump, Pam Bondi, Pete Hegseth, RFK Jr., and Linda McMahon, this administration has assembled a cast of characters whose main unifying trait is their hostility to the rights and freedoms we value.
We knew this was coming.
We prepared for the fight.
We’ve filed 40 lawsuits in the past 36 weeks — because each and every time Trump and his allies break the law, we will sue. And with the law on our side, we’re already winning many of those critical fights.
But if we’ve learned one thing from the first eight months of this administration, it’s that the onslaught of unconstitutional orders and unlawful clawbacks of state funding will continue .
They’re attacking everything from reproductive rights and the LGBTQ+ community to health care, education, and public safety.
So today, I’m coming to you for help. As Attorney General of California, I promise to remain resolute in my commitment to defending your rights and freedoms and holding this lawless administration accountable. But I need you with me to keep this up.

## Takers and givers...
There's been a lot of talk surrounding immigration in the past few months.
Democrats are complaining about Trump's deportations while Republicans cheer on our now-secure border.
But I've had another aspect of immigration on my mind--the policy itself.
The debate isn't just about who's coming in; it's about what they bring.
Some visa programs are takers, draining resources and jobs.
Others are givers, creating wealth and opportunity.
I got the chance to ask Trump what he thought about our options, and his answer was right on the money.
Let's break it down...

Friend, I grew up in public housing on the west side of Savannah, Georgia. I had 11 brothers and sisters – and while my family was short on money, we were long on love and faith.
My parents showed me the meaning of hard work – and always told us kids we could do anything we put our minds to. Thanks to their support, I became the first in my family to earn a college degree. Now, I'm fighting in the Senate to make sure every child can achieve their American dream.
But I'll be honest: To put a check on Donald Trump and start making progress on the issues that matter most, Democrats must take back the Senate. That means we need to make crucial investments in key battleground states like Georgia – right here, right now. There isn't a second to waste.

name: Pete Sepp
subject: Giving Americans a fair deal
body:
Recently, President Trump's negotiation team successfully convinced Canada to scrap its discriminatory Digital Services Tax (DST)

| | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zkoo3ron34ngvdm0n68qnv3p7avijr6ltltampo8_rp22sh2s8i6epb4s9hm4ob6c9h2bs)
Friend,

Recently, President Trump's negotiation team successfully convinced Canada to scrap its discriminatory Digital Services Tax (DST) — a move that had threatened to spike costs for U.S. businesses and ultimately hit families right in the wallet.

**This victory was essential for defending American innovation and taxpayers from unfair digital taxes.**

Now, as pivotal trade negotiation deadlines with the European Union approach, it's time to build on that victory.

The EU’s Digital Markets Act (DMA) and Digital Services Act (DSA), packed with protectionist provisions, are poised to disadvantage American firms and stifle innovation.

While the Biden administration has in the past used taxpayer dollars to collaborate with European enforcers on these measures, the National Taxpayers Union (NTU) believes the time has come for a different approach.

**We can take this proud achievement with Canada and leverage it for a fairer deal with the European Union to secure four key commitments:**
* End discriminatory EU regulations
* Ensure equal treatment under digital rules
* Pause new EU measures that disproportionately impact U.S. firms
* Demand a clear pledge to stop targeting American businesses

I am Pete Sepp, President of NTU, the “Voice of America’s Taxpayers.” We achieve favorable fiscal policy outcomes using the most effective pro-taxpayer team on Capitol Hill and in the states.

Today, I’m asking for your support to keep the momentum going.

[Please support NTU as we continue to push for a fair tax policy that helps taxpayers and business owners nationwide.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zfnq75tq7e0mgnkiq4o1m1l8sn066j0abrb50u28_rp22sh2s8i6epb4s9hm4ob6c9h2bs)

[Donate $1,000](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zbha9g9vkuksad36goajbd749k8195bfq38srpq0_rp22sh2s8i6epb4s9hm4ob6c9h2bs)

[Donate Any Amount](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2za4cnofvvghnj4kfoum2fq7iu4vmtek55og200b0_rp22sh2s8i6epb4s9hm4ob6c9h2bs)
European governments often enjoy the benefits of American innovation even as they are litigating against and extracting enormous fines from American businesses. This can happen at the very same time other countries are pushing for more access to our own markets.

**We must prioritize fairer tax and trade policies that respect both taxpayers and businesses.**

That’s where you come in, Friend.

Your support empowers NTU to:
* Amplify the message that DSTs and overreaching regulations undermine U.S. competitiveness in the digital economy.
* Advocate for a U.S. trade agenda that pushes back against the EU’s restrictive digital rules and tax schemes.
* Ensure policymakers understand that taxpayers free to trade with each other in open markets — _not foreign regulators_ — should decide what’s fair in cross-border commerce.

[Your contribution today ensures we can keep pushing for trade policies that favor innovation, competition, fewer barriers to commerce, and fiscal sanity. Click below to donate.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zm4h4f713rt7fkj9rbb224l28rjfttq9nvu5p40g_rp22sh2s8i6epb4s9hm4ob6c9h2bs)

This email is different. It's more direct.

I am reaching out this afternoon with a last-ditch request for a contribution to my campaign before our end-of-quarter fundraising drive comes to a close tonight. Here's why:

Right now, Trump’s MAGA machine is flooding Georgia with attack ads to distort my record.

**It is not normal for the GOP to be up on the airwaves and online with this kind of attack this far out from the election. It’s because they know Georgia is key. They know I’m strong. And they need to knock me down.**

_Will we let them?_

We knew these attacks were coming. But we’re facing _more_ outside spending, _earlier_ than we had expected — which means we’re going to have to ramp up our fundraising in order to fight back and set the record straight.

We will fight back. And we _will_ win. But I can’t do it alone.

I really need your help right now.

name: Pete Sepp
subject: Giving Americans a fair deal
body:
Recently, President Trump's negotiation team successfully convinced Canada to scrap its discriminatory Digital Services Tax (DST)

| | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z99jfhd1k7rrm9sgbkqr8k63k9f7hi57pj6cj890_rp22sh2s8i6epb4s9hmcpj1chh2bs)
Friend,

Recently, President Trump's negotiation team successfully convinced Canada to scrap its discriminatory Digital Services Tax (DST) — a move that had threatened to spike costs for U.S. businesses and ultimately hit families right in the wallet.

**This victory was essential for defending American innovation and taxpayers from unfair digital taxes.**

Now, as pivotal trade negotiation deadlines with the European Union approach, it's time to build on that victory.

The EU’s Digital Markets Act (DMA) and Digital Services Act (DSA), packed with protectionist provisions, are poised to disadvantage American firms and stifle innovation.

While the Biden administration has in the past used taxpayer dollars to collaborate with European enforcers on these measures, the National Taxpayers Union (NTU) believes the time has come for a different approach.

**We can take this proud achievement with Canada and leverage it for a fairer deal with the European Union to secure four key commitments:**
* End discriminatory EU regulations
* Ensure equal treatment under digital rules
* Pause new EU measures that disproportionately impact U.S. firms
* Demand a clear pledge to stop targeting American businesses

I am Pete Sepp, President of NTU, the “Voice of America’s Taxpayers.” We achieve favorable fiscal policy outcomes using the most effective pro-taxpayer team on Capitol Hill and in the states.

Today, I’m asking for your support to keep the momentum going.

[Please support NTU as we continue to push for a fair tax policy that helps taxpayers and business owners nationwide.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zjk5rg9i1l5g8148k7jsvl7uqn89b35ibjuvnfoo_rp22sh2s8i6epb4s9hmcpj1chh2bs)

[Donate $250](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zqpd5l17drcrf4drj2kkhgpvivgubsitku3shvrg_rp22sh2s8i6epb4s9hmcpj1chh2bs)

[Donate $1,000](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z21nj9i542pvrs3e8kltob20tck9f8dj90of3qfg_rp22sh2s8i6epb4s9hmcpj1chh2bs)

[Donate Any Amount](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zpvr1vngni1spprmtn8bhpjlenummasdnvr0scug_rp22sh2s8i6epb4s9hmcpj1chh2bs)
European governments often enjoy the benefits of American innovation even as they are litigating against and extracting enormous fines from American businesses. This can happen at the very same time other countries are pushing for more access to our own markets.

**We must prioritize fairer tax and trade policies that respect both taxpayers and businesses.**

That’s where you come in, Friend.

Your support empowers NTU to:
* Amplify the message that DSTs and overreaching regulations undermine U.S. competitiveness in the digital economy.
* Advocate for a U.S. trade agenda that pushes back against the EU’s restrictive digital rules and tax schemes.
* Ensure policymakers understand that taxpayers free to trade with each other in open markets — _not foreign regulators_ — should decide what’s fair in cross-border commerce.

[Your contribution today ensures we can keep pushing for trade policies that favor innovation, competition, fewer barriers to commerce, and fiscal sanity. Click below to donate.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zebnno470l0fuf6o7d0vrruqdtp7oe4npqk8khc8_rp22sh2s8i6epb4s9hmcpj1chh2bs)

Our frontline communities don’t have four years. The fight is happening right here, right now, and we need to make every second count. As you read this, Donald Trump and his MAGA bandwagon are ripping away environmental protections at record speed — fast-tracking approvals for new mining and drilling on public lands, silencing climate science, and handing out billions in tax giveaways to the very polluters destroying our future. I’ve lived long enough to know their playbook: Billionaires and fossil fuel corporations count on us staying quiet. But when we rise up together, they're afraid of us. _We have shown over and over again that the many can beat the money._ **That's why the work we do at JanePAC matters more than ever. # It's a "Knife edge" moment for the economy as the Govt Shutdown looms
A partial U.S. government **[shutdown looms](https://substack.com/redirect/986a3b76-72b3-47ca-9f0d-b3a123164fae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** at midnight Tuesday as partisan gridlock deepens, with Vice President JD Vance warning of inevitable closure amid stalled funding talks as Democrats refuse to negotiate. Experts fear it could tip the fragile economy into recession by halting vital data and services nationwide.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/986a3b76-72b3-47ca-9f0d-b3a123164fae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Playing politics with the economy:** Senator Tom Cotton issued a scorching statement suggesting a reason for Schumer's refusal to cooperate is because he **[is worried about his seat,](https://substack.com/redirect/63bdc559-5547-47c1-be4f-1ff74deee11b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** saying: _**" Chuck Schumer is shutting down the government because he's terrified of a primary from AOC. His actions are disgraceful."**_

* **Political Deadlock Escalates Tensions** : Senate leaders Schumer and Thune clashed in an Oval Office meeting, with Thune accusing Schumer of _**" purely and simply hostage taking"**_ over his obstruction. Currently there is no funding deal emerging despite repeated failed votes with the shutdown to begin at midnight tonight.
* **Democrat Demand 's:** Democrats seek to lock in COVID-era healthcare subsidies in any new deal and will not agree to a stop gap funding effort without it.
* **Economic Fragility Heightens Risks** : With labor market softening and continued high interest rates already putting a strain on U.S. growth, expert Michael Linden warns shutdown would exacerbate the _**" knife's edge"**_ vulnerability adding that _**" Adding a government shutdown to the mix certainly won't help."**_
* **Data Blackout Disrupts Markets** : Cessation of federal economic report creation due to the shutdown could also blind investors and the Federal Reserve to key inflation and jobs indicators ahead of October policy decisions.
* **Trump Firings Threaten Permanence** : The Trump administration is also eyeing mass layoffs of federal workers if the impasse persists, which would be beyond the routine unpaid furloughs and park closures.

# Radio Shack and Pier1 owners BUSTED over $112M Ponzi Scheme by the SEC
The SEC on Tuesday charged Alex Mehr and Tai Lopez, founders of Retail E-commerce Ventures that acquired bankrupt chains like RadioShack and Pier 1 Imports, with **[orchestrating a $112 million Ponzi scheme,](https://substack.com/redirect/a3f2bf1b-2e5f-454a-8147-46c250284b62?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** luring investors with false promises of sky-high returns on floundering retail brands from April 2020 to November 2022.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a3f2bf1b-2e5f-454a-8147-46c250284b62?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **SEC Alleges Fraudulent Promises:** Executives sold unsecured notes and shares touting up to 25% annual returns, misrepresenting unprofitable brands as thriving cash cows via hype videos and materials.
* **Investor Funds Mismanaged:** The executives raised $112 million purportedly for brand acquisitions, but instead used it to pay $5.9 million in returns to earlier backers and siphon $16.1 million personally.
* **Brands Faced Inevitable Collapse:** Companies like Modell's Sporting Goods and Dress Barn generated revenue but zero profits, defaulting on debts and selling to Omni Retail Enterprises.
* **Legal Reckoning Unfolds:** Complaint filed in Southern District of Florida seeks injunctions, disgorgement of gains, and penalties amid broader scrutiny of REV's opaque operations.

# JPM Chase will be the worlds first Megabank run by AI
JPMorgan Chase, the world's largest bank by market cap, is transforming into the **[first fully AI-powered megabank](https://substack.com/redirect/9311da7b-699a-41ba-9ef7-a21794c40d0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , deploying advanced large language models to automate investment banking decks and M&A memos, chief data analytics officer Derek Waldron announced Tuesday.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9311da7b-699a-41ba-9ef7-a21794c40d0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Massive Workforce AI Access:** 250,000 employees (excluding branch and call center staff) now use the LLM Suite daily, powered by OpenAI and Anthropic models updated every eight weeks with internal data.
* **Agentic AI Deployment Accelerates:** The bank shifting to _**" agentic"**_ AI for multistep tasks, slashing creation time for five-page investment decks from hours to 30 seconds.
* **Staff Reduction Looms Ahead:** Consumer banking operations staff are projected to drop at least 10% in five years; junior banker jobs are also eyed for cuts, with half relocated to low-cost hubs like India and Argentina.
* **Industry Edge Emerges Boldly:** Chase's intention is to reshape finance with more AI-driven processes while prioritizing client-facing roles.

* * *
* * *
# DoorDash unleashes a delivery robot revolution on Phoenix
DoorDash **[launched its autonomous delivery robot Dot on Tuesday](https://substack.com/redirect/766759e1-f246-47a4-a98f-06825a4535c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , zipping through Phoenix sidewalks at 20 mph with lidar smarts and pizza-hauling muscle--up to six boxes--to slash missing orders and conquer urban chaos.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/766759e1-f246-47a4-a98f-06825a4535c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Dot 's Tech Arsenal Unveiled: **Equipped with eight cameras, three lidar sensors, and an internal food-check cam, Dot navigates streets and lots while weighing orders to cut complaints by 30%.
* **Phoenix Testing Grounds Activated:** Already trialed in Phoenix, Dot opens to local merchants via DoorDash's new platform, blending robot runs with drone options for faster urban deliveries.
* **Execs Champion Autonomy Surge:** Co-founder Stanley Tang calls Dot a game-changer for complex routes, filling gaps no off-the-shelf tech can handle in DoorDash's massive ecosystem.
* **Rivals Heat Up Robo-Race:** Amid Uber's drone and Waymo tie-ups, DoorDash eyes nationwide expansion, arming merchants with tools to boost efficiency and customer satisfaction.

* * *
* * *
# **" Rosie" is the swankiest drone killing turret after manufacturing mistake**
Defense startup Allen Control Systems unveiled a **[flashy rose-gold version](https://substack.com/redirect/e514664f-2935-447c-befc-ff0f1cc6718f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** of its AI-powered Bullfrog anti-drone weapon after an ordering blunder, showcasing tech that autonomously detects and blasts incoming drones up to 800 meters away to counter battlefield threats.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e514664f-2935-447c-befc-ff0f1cc6718f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **AI Detection Revolution** : Bullfrog employs electro-optical scanners and game-trained AI to identify drone models instantly, adapting to new threats without radar's detectable emissions.
* **Autonomous Targeting Edge** : System enables hands-off operation for rapid hits on fast-moving Group 1-3 drones, or joystick control, filling gaps in tank defenses exposed in Ukraine.
* **Military Integration Push** : Founders pitch Bullfrog for Army and SOCOM contracts, eyeing vehicle mounts on Bradleys under the Transforming in Contact initiative.
* **Global Glam Appeal** : CEO jokes rose-gold "Rosie" could lure Saudi and Emirati buyers, backed by cheeky merch like "If it flies, it dies" t-shirts.

body:
Honestly, we’re spending down resources. And to turn that around, I need supporters who understand how important this work is to chip in.
#

Folks, Mark Kelly here. And in a minute or so, I’m going to ask you to make a donation to my campaign. If you have the time, give me a chance to explain why this request is especially important today.
Here’s the truth:
In 2020, we won what was arguably the most hotly contested Senate race in the entire country.
In 2022, we had to run again. We won an incredibly competitive race — and by an even bigger margin that time.
In 2024, I hit the road. I fundraised, gave speeches, advised, and supported as many candidates as I could. In a tough year for Democrats, we pulled out some important victories.
And now, in 2026, I’ve taken a formal position as Vice Chair of the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee, where I strategize and fundraise for the Senate candidates we’ll need to take back the chamber.
I’m a firm believer that running strong campaigns makes a difference. I wouldn’t be in the Senate if we didn’t take every campaign seriously — and if I can help other candidates do the same, I have to. Maybe it’s the decades of Navy service in me, but I’ll always jump at the chance to make an impact.
But all this work, the travel, the town halls, the media, the staffing — it’s not free, believe it or not. There’s a significant cost. And while the first half of the year was an extremely strong period for fundraising, this second half has been significantly more difficult.
Honestly, we’re spending down resources. And to turn that around, I need supporters who understand how important this work is to chip in what they can, when they can.
So, I’m asking you, humbly: [**Can you make a donation to my campaign? Help us keep up this nationwide mobilization, because investments now will pay huge electoral dividends when next November comes around.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-sep25.BngWNQ&refcode=em250930-2-f&t=1&akid=6205%2E6688874%2E-0Uvhu)

---
Dear Fellow Patriot,Today –- right now -- you and I have our best chance to stop anti-America billionaire and globalist George Soros. **[And it depends on your rapid response to this urgent message – will you sign your STOP SOROS petition right away?](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zmiuovtoacjrhfrdlolqv53p3n8uvvh76cc2bmfg_rp22sh2s8i6epb4s9hm6p74cdh2bs) ** You’re one of America’s most informed seniors, so you know that George Soros has injected his poisonous ideas into every corner of American life: education, media, elections, and our justice system.And the results are disastrous for the nation we love.
---
>> We now have a generation of radicalized young people who hate America and American values. >> George Soros has tentacles everywhere influencing the news and information a majority of Americans see and read. Now he even has majority stake in the second largest radio network in America acquired through a shady Biden FCC deal.>> George Soros’ push for the decriminalization of drugs has led to the worst drug crisis in American history. I hope no one you love has gotten tangled up in this! >> George Soros has hijacked our justice system by channeling millions into electing dozens and dozens of hand-picked radical left District Attorneys.
---
This includes New York’s horrible Letitia James who’s now using every trick in the book to try and stop President Trump and his DOGE efforts. But none of that compares to what George Soros and his heir apparent, Alex Soros, are doing to flood sovereign nations like ours with overwhelming waves of illegal migrants.It’s their way of reshaping our population and setting themselves up as the puppet-masters for all future elections. Their ability to alter entire nations is so potent that Soros’ native country of Hungary passed legislation they call the “Stop Soros Law.”The law made it a crime to aid illegal immigration so Soros couldn’t drown Hungary with illegal migrants in defiance of the government and the will of rightful citizens.That’s exactly the kind of common sense we need here. **[It’s why AMAC Action is spearheading this historic STOP SOROS petition drive – and why I need your name on the petition RIGHT AWAY!](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zbjckfrdtdi4kast6buqu0unt7s0bqqt5fp87bbo_rp22sh2s8i6epb4s9hm6p74cdh2bs)**

Your petition demands that House Speaker Mike Johnson take immediate steps to introduce, advance, and support legislation to neutralize George Soros’ globalist goals. Chances are good that we’ll lose the House or the Senate –- or both. So to pass legislation, we must move now.Great change comes from embracing great opportunities – and if you want to change this situation where a foreign billionaire is destroying the country we love from within... **[...your signature on your STOP SOROS petition is the greatest opportunity you will have before 20 months is up.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z2ulok5mdc6dt68voku66ahh857ugi28vv3k3s28_rp22sh2s8i6epb4s9hm6p74cdh2bs) ****My fellow patriot, my name is Rebecca Weber and I’m the Chairwoman of AMAC Action. ** “AMAC” stands for Association of Mature American Citizens. And when it comes to standing up for the rights of conservative seniors, “action” is what we’re known for.**With its 2 million members, AMAC is the conservative antidote to left-leaning AARP. And our 75 chapters and 300 volunteer delegates makes our advocacy group, AMAC Action, a force to be reckoned with on Capitol Hill.** And unlike the AARP, we’re fighting against George Soros not alongside him.You see, according to public tax filings, over three years, the AARP accepted more than 10 MILLION DOLLARS from the George Soros-funded Tides Foundation.The Tides Foundation says they are on the forefront of “climate justice, racial equity, reproductive freedom” and their mission is “justice and equity.”You know that’s just globalist speak for ‘destroy America and redistribute its power and wealth to radicals.’And listen to this... the AARP once honored George Soros on the cover of their magazine calling him one of “America’s Greatest Innovators” who’s**** “changing the world, $100 million at a time.” It makes my stomach turn to see so many seniors supporting the AARP not knowing it’s under the influence of the radical George Soros-funded Tides Foundation.But today, I’m not writing to those seniors. **[I’m writing to YOU because YOU understand the George Soros threat. And I have faith that you will seize this time-sensitive opportunity to do something about it.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zu0uq4puj47kk0sauurcfqvtsa7ig0iuj44tlar8_rp22sh2s8i6epb4s9hm6p74cdh2bs) **If the AARP wants to betray America’s seniors by supporting dangerous leftists like George Soros, they are free to do so. **But AMAC Action is leading the charge to bombard Congress with STOP SOROS petitions demanding they introduce, advance, and support legislation to shut-down this dangerous America hater once and for all.**** ****And we would be honored to have you by our side.** **[Please sign your STOP SOROS petition right away, and make a one-time contribution of $35 to help AMAC Action collect and send the millions of petitions we’ll need in the next 20 months.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zoe6rs9att7avitnqibscj9fesp46dt192ofjesg_rp22sh2s8i6epb4s9hm6p74cdh2bs) ** AMAC Action doesn’t take a dime of taxpayer funding. And we’re certainly not bought and paid for by George Soros or any of his dark money groups like the Tides Foundation.Our funding comes from grassroots conservatives like you who care deeply about the future of America.We answer to you -- not to George and Alex Soros. With that said, if you’re able to make a larger emergency gift of $50, $75, $100, $150, $250, $500, or even $1,000 -- please do it.**[We have a lot of work to do to STOP SOROS and time is not on our side.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zcggtrf1o928m0ljimqfrnpsrjr6p3r45hf7h250_rp22sh2s8i6epb4s9hm6p74cdh2bs) **Thank you for joining us in this fight for America.

**Rebecca Weber,_Chairwoman_****AMAC Action**

It's looking incredibly likely that the federal government is going to shut down tonight--and it's happening because Donald Trump is too arrogant and too goddamn stupid to work with Democrats to stop it.
Yesterday on my show, I had Sarah Longwell on--someone I respect a lot--and she dropped a term I hadn't heard before to describe how Republicans plan to win this fight: _narrative dominance._
_**[I'm committed to keeping Endless Urgency free for everyone--but I rely on paid subscribers (starting at just $8/month) to keep it going. If you find value in the work, consider becoming a paid subscriber:](https://substack.com/redirect/41278a2b-f1fb-42ff-8aa3-1de3dd338177?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/41278a2b-f1fb-42ff-8aa3-1de3dd338177?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Right now, flip on any conservative outlet, MAGA influencer, or Trump himself, and you'll hear the same lie on repeat: that Democrats are shutting down the government to hand money to undocumented immigrants. That's flatly, objectively false. Democrats are holding the line to undo brutal Republican budget cuts, to reverse the damage of Trump's tariffs, and to protect health care for millions.
And they're right to draw that line. The truth is, the party in power always gets blamed for shutdowns--just like Trump did the last two times this happened. But none of that matters to him. He refuses to make concessions, refuses to look weak, and frankly, he's too incompetent to even understand what governing requires--let alone how his actions are screwing over the American people.
Here's the real danger: Democrats could lose this fight if they don't seize the narrative. We need to make damn sure the public understands this isn't about opposing a clean continuing resolution just to be difficult. We're doing it to stop your health insurance premiums from going through the roof. We're doing it to end Trump's tariffs and lower prices. We're doing it to reverse vicious GOP cuts--like slashing school lunches for 12 million kids and gutting community policing programs.
But that message isn't going to cut through with a couple of press conferences. We need the right messengers--and a lot more than just party leadership. Democrats love to wait for the official talking points before jumping in. Meanwhile, Republicans are already on the attack. They've got their narratives and they act on them. They're not sitting on endless Zoom calls debating the language of a tweet.
_**[I'm committed to keeping Endless Urgency free for everyone--but I rely on paid subscribers (starting at just $8/month) to keep it going. If you find value in the work, consider becoming a paid subscriber:](https://substack.com/redirect/41278a2b-f1fb-42ff-8aa3-1de3dd338177?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/41278a2b-f1fb-42ff-8aa3-1de3dd338177?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
If Democrats want narrative dominance--if we want to win this fight, take back the House, and crush the midterms--we've got to move fast and hit hard. And people need the freedom to screw up while doing it. That's where we're stumbling right now.
We might win this shutdown fight the same way we won the budget fight--by hammering the same message, nonstop. The Republican budget was wildly destructive and hurtful, and Democrats largely stayed glued to that point, which is why the budget is so unpopular (it's also just self-evidently bad and hard for the Republicans to spin).
But as Sarah said on the show, this isn't something one CNN hit or press release will fix. It'll take thousands of messengers--politicians, influencers, activists--across every platform: TV, YouTube, podcasts, social. And they've got to push the message with urgency and clarity.
Republicans never stop communicating with their base--or the country. Their message is always the same: _Democrats are bad. Democrats are hurting you. Democrats are the problem._ That line works when you're out of power. But it starts to crumble when you're the one running the show. That's part of why Trump's approval rating is stuck in the low 40s.
Democrats need their own version. Step one: _Republicans are bad, and what they 're doing is hurting you._ Step two: _Here 's what we're fighting for, and here's how it helps you._ Because right now, even among Democratic voters, you still hear: "Yeah, Democrats want to help... but not me." That's a huge problem, and we don't win until we can get quality, effective answers to that.
The Democratic Party has to be seen as fighting for real people--especially people getting hammered by this economy. That's what this shutdown is about. It's about stopping cruel budget cuts. It's about saving ACA tax credits so people don't get crushed by 75% premium hikes. It's about killing tariffs that are jacking up prices on everything from groceries to appliances.
We need to go hard on this. Every hour, every day. Push through the noise. Don't get sidetracked dunking on every dumbass MAGA outburst--like Hegseth's unhinged speech to the generals earlier today. Stay focused (yes, that goes for me too!). This is a fight that actually affects people's lives.
If Democrats win this--if we stop the cuts, block the premium spikes, and reclaim tariff power--we'll have done something real for millions of Americans. And we need to shout that from the rooftops. Remind people what we fought for, while Republicans were busy fear-mongering about immigrants. It's ridiculous. It's a lie. But they repeat it so often, people start to believe it--or just tune out entirely.
We don't have time for distractions. Republicans are terrified we'll win the midterms. That's why they're gerrymandering the hell out of their states. Their swagger? It's fear in disguise. Trump's out here claiming he has a 60% approval rating and that inflation doesn't exist. It's complete bullshit.
We can win this--but only if we build narrative dominance. That means getting tougher, getting louder, and putting everyone in the fight. Not just Hakeem Jeffries. Not just Chuck Schumer. Every single Democrat in Congress should be on TV, TikTok, Instagram, local radio--_everywhere_ --pushing the same message. If you can't do that, you shouldn't have the job.

Peter, we’re approaching our next FEC deadline tonight. Hits at midnight.
That deadline comes at a moment unlike any other in our nation’s history.
I served in Iraq as a Marine at the height of the war, about 20 years ago. All those years ago, I never thought I’d see a president as lawless as this one. I never thought I’d see the President of the United States blatantly ignore the Supreme Court. I signed up to serve to defend our Constitution — to make sure exactly that kind of thing never happened at home.
This is authoritarianism. It is here. And we need to stand up now or risk losing the rights and liberties we were born with.

That’s why I’m getting on cable news all the time. It’s why I’m doing podcasts and social media, interviews with local and national papers. It’s why I’m doing town halls all over the country, and why I hope to do more soon.
That’s what I did in my campaign. It’s what I’ve been doing since I got elected. And I’m going to keep doing it as long as I have to until we start to break through to people.

**But Republicans have full control of the government. They’re in charge and they have the responsibility to govern. If they want to foolishly shut the government down, that’s their choice.**
Democrats have been laying out a clear line: we want to lower costs and protect healthcare.
People have been getting pounded because of Trump’s chaotic trade war (and that’s coming from a guy from the Rust Belt), healthcare cuts, and high costs across the board. Millions of folks across the country are about to lose care, and if not, be pounded with increased health insurance premiums.

Dear Fellow Patriot,Today –- right now -- you and I have our best chance to stop anti-America billionaire and globalist George Soros. **[And it depends on your rapid response to this urgent message – will you sign your STOP SOROS petition right away?](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z7v8bcgnrmr1gsbeb76q44ctfr44s9sh29naosqg_rp22sh2s8i6epb4s9hm1pr0cth2bs) ** You’re one of America’s most informed seniors, so you know that George Soros has injected his poisonous ideas into every corner of American life: education, media, elections, and our justice system.And the results are disastrous for the nation we love.

>> We now have a generation of radicalized young people who hate America and American values. >> George Soros has tentacles everywhere influencing the news and information a majority of Americans see and read. Now he even has majority stake in the second largest radio network in America acquired through a shady Biden FCC deal.>> George Soros’ push for the decriminalization of drugs has led to the worst drug crisis in American history. I hope no one you love has gotten tangled up in this! >> George Soros has hijacked our justice system by channeling millions into electing dozens and dozens of hand-picked radical left District Attorneys.
---
This includes New York’s horrible Letitia James who’s now using every trick in the book to try and stop President Trump and his DOGE efforts. But none of that compares to what George Soros and his heir apparent, Alex Soros, are doing to flood sovereign nations like ours with overwhelming waves of illegal migrants.It’s their way of reshaping our population and setting themselves up as the puppet-masters for all future elections. Their ability to alter entire nations is so potent that Soros’ native country of Hungary passed legislation they call the “Stop Soros Law.”The law made it a crime to aid illegal immigration so Soros couldn’t drown Hungary with illegal migrants in defiance of the government and the will of rightful citizens.That’s exactly the kind of common sense we need here. **[It’s why AMAC Action is spearheading this historic STOP SOROS petition drive – and why I need your name on the petition RIGHT AWAY!](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z6acka284lslri1b4mtis91m7qpeki6r3ii1h4f0_rp22sh2s8i6epb4s9hm1pr0cth2bs)**

---
Your petition demands that House Speaker Mike Johnson take immediate steps to introduce, advance, and support legislation to neutralize George Soros’ globalist goals. If the Hungarians can get it done, so can we!After the “Stop Soros Law” passed in Hungary, Soros pulled his dark money, equity-seeking, non-governmental organization, the Open Society Foundation, out of Hungary because of the pressure! His open border plans were thwarted.And he turned his attention to us. **Why are we allowing George Soros to sit behind the walls of his sprawling compound in Westchester County, New York, exploiting the wealth he accumulated using our capitalist system...****...to turn our young people, media, elections, and justice system against us??** My fellow patriot, right now the Trump FCC is investigating a Soros-backed radio station that broadcast the live locations of undercover ICE agents who were arriving for deportation operations. **Yes, the George Soros-funded radio station tipped off the criminals!** There are no two ways about it. **_George Soros and his son Alex Soros are enemies of our nation, its people, and our rule of law._** We must make a move against them just like Hungary did.**_And we only have 20 months to do it._** On November 3rd, 2026, Americans head back to the polls for the midterm elections. Chances are good that we’ll lose the House or the Senate –- or both. subject: They want to scare us into silence. But courage is stronger than fear.
body:
[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/18910?refcode=em20250930-1547-foote&t=1001&akid=1547%2E342411%2EhwHR7p ]Squad Victory Fund

Peter,

I’m reaching out today because tonight’s end-of-quarter deadline is one of
the most important moments for our movement this year.

The Squad is counting on this team to [ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20250930-1-movement.mNmZBm&refcode=em20250930-1547&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=1547%2E342411%2EhwHR7p ]help us reach our $30,000
fundraising goal — and I know we can get there if we all step up together.

We’re on the front lines: calling out blatant attacks on our democracy,
pushing back against the harm caused by Trump and his billionaire backers,
and fighting for a future where everyone has the freedom to thrive.

We’re confronting the same powerful forces that have always tried to
silence progress and marginalize our communities. And make no mistake:
they will do whatever it takes to defeat us.

Unlike most in Congress, we don’t take money from billionaires or
corporate PACs. Instead, our movement is powered by people — teachers,
nurses, activists, neighbors — who believe our democracy should serve and
center everyone, not just the wealthy few.

That’s why the attacks on the Squad are relentless. We are targeted
because we dare to imagine — and fight for — a better future: Medicare for
All, economic justice, reproductive freedom, an end to endless wars, and a
democracy that works for every single one of us.

They want to scare us into silence. But courage is stronger than fear. And
people power is stronger than corporate money.

If we fall short tonight, the opposition will be emboldened to continue
their reckless escalation. But if we rise to this challenge and reach our
$30,000 goal, we’ll send a clear message: our movement is strong,
resilient, and ready to win.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20250930-1-movement.mNmZBm&refcode=em20250930-1547&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=1547%2E342411%2EhwHR7p ]So I’m asking: will you chip in to the Squad Victory Fund before
tonight’s midnight deadline? Your support today will show that when we
come together, we are unstoppable.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20250930-1-movement.mNmZBm&refcode=em20250930-1547&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=1547%2E342411%2EhwHR7p ]Contribute ››

In solidarity,

Ilhan

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe:

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.squadvictoryfund.com/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=1547%2E342411%2EhwHR7p

Paid for by The Squad Victory Fund, a joint fundraising committee authorized by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, Ilhan for Congress, The Committee to Elect Ayanna Pressley, Rashida Tlaib for Congress, Courage to Change, Inspiring Leadership Has a Name PAC, Power of Us PAC, and Rooted in Community Leadership PAC.

In addition to what’s legally required, The Squad Victory Fund does not accept contributions from: (1) corporations, associations, or their PACs; (2) individuals registered as federal lobbyists or under FARA; (3) from the PACs, lobbyists, or SEC-named executives of fossil fuel companies; or (4) from the Fraternal Order of Police.

Contributions or gifts to The Squad Victory Fund are not tax deductible.

Contributions to The Squad Victory Fund will be allocated equally among: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, Ilhan for Congress, The Committee to Elect Ayanna Pressley, Rashida Tlaib for Congress, Courage to Change, Inspiring Leadership Has a Name PAC, Power of Us PAC, and Rooted in Community Leadership PAC.

Any contributor may designate their contribution for a particular participant. The allocation formula above may change if any contributor makes a contribution that, when allocated, would exceed the amount that the contributor may lawfully give to any participant.

After contributing to The Squad Victory Fund, you will automatically be signed up to receive email updates from Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, Ilhan for Congress, The Committee to Elect Ayanna Pressley, and Rashida Tlaib for Congress. You may of course opt-out by unsubscribing at any time.

To contribute via check, please address to The Squad Victory Fund c/o MBA Consulting Group, PO Box 15845, Washington D.C., 20003

Email us: info@squadvictoryfund.com

https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]
Peter,

body:
Whether you live somewhere with elections in 2025 or not, voter registration is critical work to protect our democracy. We have to do everything we can to bring in new voters, lapsed voters, and voters who have moved and make sure their voice is heard in their next election, whether that's in a few weeks or next year.
Make a difference for our country and RUSH $24 or more for our voter registration efforts right now >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=093025_2&amount=24]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
2025 may be an "off year" election as far as Congress goes, but that doesn't mean we don't have important elections this year or we can take a break with our voter registration work, folks.
Voter registration is open in New Jersey until October 14th -- and early voting starts on October 25th. Control of their state legislature hangs in the balance, while it's also an open race for governor as the current governor is term-limited.
Voters can register in Virginia until October 24th , with early voting starting on September 19th. Virginia's legislature is also up for grabs, plus the opportunity to replace the current vote-suppressing governor (who is term-limited) with someone who will protect voting in the commonwealth again.
Our mission is simple: The more people who vote, the more our government looks like we, the people. But to get to the point where every voice is heard, we need your help .
It costs us roughly $3 to register a new voter. Will you chip in $24 or more today to help register 8 new voters? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=093025_2&amount=24]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

Yes, there have been a few special elections to fill vacancies, but these elections are our first real opportunity to fight back against the widespread efforts to dismantle our democracy. The results will determine whether our country stays mired in the darkness and conspiracy theories we hear every day or if we can reclaim our rights -- from voting to choice and more -- and keep working toward a better future.
Voter participation has been increasing, and young people -- a major target of opponents of voting rights -- see the importance of voting now more than ever. Voting quickly becomes a habit -- a habit our democracy sorely needs to fulfill the promise of the American dream. Overwhelming states nationwide with new voter registrations can help turn the tide against the voter suppression laws we've seen passed the last few years.
New voter registration -- at just about $3 per new voter -- will absolutely tip the scales of these elections towards justice. Please pitch in with $24 or whatever you can to help us register a tidal wave of new voters this year! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=093025_2&amount=24]
Thank you,
Voter Action Project's Registration Team

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Here’s where things stand on the shutdown
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2668%2E4032634%2EteM31U)
---
Once again, Republicans have brought us to the brink of a government shutdown if Congress does not pass a budget before midnight tonight. I want to talk about how we got here, and where things stand right now. This summer, Republicans passed a law that eliminates health care benefits for 15 million people and makes the biggest cuts to health care in modern history — all to give a trillion dollars in tax handouts to billionaires and billionaire corporations. What does cutting a trillion dollars out of our health care budget actually look like? Rural hospitals will be closed. Seniors in nursing homes who rely on Medicaid will be kicked to the curb. People will entirely lose the coverage they rely on. Medical research for cancer and Alzheimer's will end. And people will get letters in the mail telling them that their monthly insurance costs are going to go way, way, way up. In fact, your health care premium could more than double if Congress fails to act. This will affect the cost of health care for everybody in America. So Democrats are telling Republicans that if they want our help funding the Trump administration, then they’ve got to restore health care funding before millions of people get hurt. We’re not even asking for new money here. We just want the government to restore that health care funding, roll back the medical research cuts, and prevent insurance premiums from going up. What are Republicans saying to that? “No.” They refuse to even negotiate. They don't want to talk about it. Donald Trump has told them to walk away. They are just crossing their arms and saying, “No.” So it seems like Republicans are forging ahead with their plan to shut down the government rather than restore health care for millions of Americans. They don’t care about the consequences it will have on you or your family. Democrats should not stand by and hand over our votes while millions of people face higher costs and lose their access to health care. NOW is the time to use our votes in the Senate to fight for the American people. That’s our job. This isn't about politics. This is about fighting for what is right. This is about getting people health care. Republicans are going to try to put the blame on anyone but themselves. They own this health care crisis. And Donald Trump is in charge of the White House and Republicans control both chambers of Congress. They will own this government shutdown — a shutdown that will create even more chaos and economic stress. It doesn’t have to be this way. I’m going to continue urging the Republicans to sit down with us and pass a budget that keeps the government running and restores health care funding. This is a fight worth having. We can't just hand a blank check to Donald Trump and say, “Do whatever you want.” Now is the time to stand up for our values, and I’m in this fight all the way. More from me soon, Elizabeth

clean_body: | | | Once again, Republicans have brought us to the brink of a government shutdown if Congress does not pass a budget before midnight tonight. I want to talk about how we got here, and where things stand right now. This summer, Republicans passed a law that eliminates health care benefits for 15 million people and makes the biggest cuts to health care in modern history — all to give a trillion dollars in tax handouts to billionaires and billionaire corporations. What does cutting a trillion dollars out of our health care budget actually look like? Rural hospitals will be closed. Seniors in nursing homes who rely on Medicaid will be kicked to the curb. People will entirely lose the coverage they rely on. Medical research for cancer and Alzheimer's will end. And people will get letters in the mail telling them that their monthly insurance costs are going to go way, way, way up. In fact, your health care premium could more than double if Congress fails to act. This will affect the cost of health care for everybody in America. So Democrats are telling Republicans that if they want our help funding the Trump administration, then they’ve got to restore health care funding before millions of people get hurt. We’re not even asking for new money here. We just want the government to restore that health care funding, roll back the medical research cuts, and prevent insurance premiums from going up. What are Republicans saying to that? “No.” They refuse to even negotiate. They don't want to talk about it. Donald Trump has told them to walk away. They are just crossing their arms and saying, “No.” So it seems like Republicans are forging ahead with their plan to shut down the government rather than restore health care for millions of Americans. They don’t care about the consequences it will have on you or your family. Democrats should not stand by and hand over our votes while millions of people face higher costs and lose their access to health care. NOW is the time to use our votes in the Senate to fight for the American people. That’s our job. This isn't about politics. This is about fighting for what is right. This is about getting people health care. Republicans are going to try to put the blame on anyone but themselves. They own this health care crisis. And Donald Trump is in charge of the White House and Republicans control both chambers of Congress. They will own this government shutdown — a shutdown that will create even more chaos and economic stress. It doesn’t have to be this way. I’m going to continue urging the Republicans to sit down with us and pass a budget that keeps the government running and restores health care funding. This is a fight worth having. We can't just hand a blank check to Donald Trump and say, “Do whatever you want.” Now is the time to stand up for our values, and I’m in this fight all the way. Peter,
Prepare to see a lot of headlines about Pennsylvania’s State Supreme Court race.
According to _The Downballot_ , conservative operatives are airing ads urging the state’s voters to oust three pro-democracy justices in the upcoming November elections. They’ve pledged to spend millions of dollars going after judicial candidates this year.
Listen, Peter, Pennsylvania is a battleground state that will be crucial in the next presidential election. And control of the Keystone State’s Supreme Court will determine whether or not free and fair elections are protected for years to come.
**Let’s be clear: In 2018, the court struck down an effort to gerrymander Pennsylvania's maps. So now, anti-democracy forces want to remove justices from the bench to ensure they can pursue their goal of extreme partisan redistricting.**
Looking ahead to the outcome of this critical election, we know these justices will make court decisions that will impact the lives of Pennsylvanians and the future of our democracy on issues ranging from blatant map manipulation and voting rights to reproductive freedom.
**All On The Line is mobilizing voters to engage in Pennsylvania and critical state-level races across the country to ensure we have fair maps and a democracy that represents the will of the people.**

Dear Peter,
Sometimes I’m asked why I’m running for governor. The answer is simple: **I feel the same call to serve now that I did when I first ran for office in 2018.**
Right now, so many of our fundamental freedoms are under attack from the Trump Administration. Immigrants are being targeted in their homes and schools. Critics are being silenced in the media. Women’s reproductive freedom is at risk nationwide. And our economy is only working for the rich and well-connected—not working families.
I’m running to stand up to these attacks—and I need your help to do it. **[Can you chip in $5 to help us hit our $200,000 end-of-quarter goal before midnight?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_kp_20250930_1_ak?refcode=em20250930-40223&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=40223_3422442_yE_qiP&akid=40223%2E3422442%2EyE_qiP)**

**As governor, I won’t let that power go to waste.** I’m ready with bold ideas to lower costs, tackle our housing crisis, and help every Californian thrive free from Trump’s authoritarian tactics.
But this race is highly competitive, and we can’t afford to fall behind. The only way we win is by proving the size and strength of our movement. That’s where you come in.

| | | Peter, In July this year, we endorsed Randy Villegas for Congress in California’s 22nd District. He’s a true working class champion looking to unseat David Valadao — one of the many Republicans who helped Trump slash Medicaid for millions of families. But first Randy needs to win his primary, and we just learned something shocking about his Democratic opponent. According to a new report, Jasmeet Bains — Villegas’ opponent in the Democratic primary — **has previously taken more than $250,000 from 53 corporations and corporate PACS that have also contributed to the Republican incumbent, David Valadao. And it’s why we need to have his back.** [Randy is facing a crucial FEC fundraising deadline TONIGHT. These deadlines are what donors, organizations, and polls look at to decide which candidates have the infrastructure to win the whole thing. And let’s not forget about the GOP’s Big Ugly Bill that rips health care away from Americans, slashes food assistance, weakens public education, and so much more — just to give tax cuts to the richest Americans.

Friend,
We're hours away from a government shutdown, and our opponent, Kevin Kiley, has made his stance on the budget talks clear— he will not concede to the "far left" and their demands.
The demands that Democrats brought to the table?
Preventing an extreme increase in ACA health insurance premiums that are estimated to increase by $700 per year.
It's sad that ensuring that our communities have access to healthcare is seen as "radical" or "extreme." But it's not surprising that Kevin Kiley continues to use the same language that Trump does to divide our country and discredit attempts at real meaningful change.
Friend, we'll never see results if we don't unseat the toxic politicians who've sold out working people for a political career serving billionaires and party bosses.
Heidi is running a people-powered campaign to fight back and deliver results for our district. But we can only kick out Kevin Kiley with your help. Our End of Quarter Deadline TONIGHT, and we still need to raise $8,519 online to reach our goal and have the resources we need to take on Kiley's wealthy donors. Can you chip in? Raised by parents who had persisted to make a middle-class life for their kids in Contra Costa County while lifting up others, Heidi was taught to push through and overcome challenges rather than complain about them. She learned to stick up for the vulnerable, to respect working people, and to value equal opportunity and justice.
After graduating from Pomona College and earning graduate degrees from Columbia and Rutgers, Heidi went to work for the Rockefeller Foundation promoting reproductive care and then began her career at the Environmental Protection Agency, stopping the dumping of toxic waste and holding corporate polluters accountable.
Today, Heidi chairs the Nevada County Board of Supervisors, where she’s taken on homelessness, expanded broadband access, and worked to reduce crime and illegal cannabis growth. Heidi flipped her seat from red to blue – and now she’s ready to do it again in Congress to take on toxic politics in Washington and put people first.

| | Dear Friends, We're down to the wire. **Tonight is the end-of-quarter deadline** , and we're **within striking distance** of our goal. Your support right now will help us close the books strong and power the final stretch--because we've got **just about a month left until the General Election**. Here's what this race is about: making King County accountable, accessible, and responsive. After the troubling findings of an audit I called for, I successfully passed legislation to require greater oversight of county grants **so that we never see this level of waste or potential fraud again!** We must ensure taxpayers get the accountability they deserve. That message is resonating, but we need the resources to keep it on the air, at the doors, and in inboxes across the County. If you believe taxpayers deserve a county that **shows up to work and delivers for residents** , I'm asking you to chip in before midnight: **_[Please donate today!](https://reagandunn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0220f14f6bfeefc23687abe64&id=8605719fa4&e=77eef70c61)_** Every dollar we raise today goes straight into voter contact--digital ads, mail, and ground game--to make sure we win in November and deliver a County government that works for you. Thank you for standing with me at this critical moment. With gratitude, Reagan Dunn
King County Councilmember P.S. **End-of-quarter funds are reported publicly** --a strong finish tonight shows we have the momentum heading into the last month. Please give what you can right now. name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 9/30/2025
body:
Durango 9-R’s Monday update comes as parents dispute the “misinformation” label
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
🎙️ Check out today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)! Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Colorado faces both grief and tough choices. Parents are [clashing with Durango 9-R](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) after officials dismissed criticism of gender policies and spending as “misinformation,” while in Vail a teacher apologized for remarks about Charlie Kirk and Trump that ignited a [free speech fight](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). A [bomb scare in Brush](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) closed schools, highlighting safety concerns statewide. Cattlemen are pushing back on [federal land restrictions](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) they say endanger their livelihoods, and Lakewood officials are defending zoning changes against claims they’ll [erase single-family neighborhoods](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). On the ballot this fall, voters will weigh a [TABOR override to fund free school lunches](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)[ and a tax hike on higher earners](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), even as Evergreen mourns last week’s shooting where [two heroic teens saved lives](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
**🇺🇸 On the National Stage...** America is navigating divides over energy, faith, and politics. President Trump [unveiled a $625 million coal plan](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to secure cheap, reliable power, while tragedy struck Michigan when a gunman [killed four and wounded eight](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) at an LDS church—an attack the White House tied to [anti-Mormon hate](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and Trump called “an attack on Christians.” Meanwhile, the Obama Foundation faces scrutiny after [millions in donations were funneled to the Tides Foundation](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), which has funded anti-Israel activism at Ivy League schools.
🗣️ **Commentary Spotlight...** This week’s commentaries stress freedom and responsibility. Andy Jones argues the[]() Nov. 4 [Douglas County school board election is pivotal](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), crediting conservatives with raising graduation rates and test scores while urging voters to back the “Common Sense” slate. Brianna Ladapo hails Florida’s end to vaccine mandates as a [win for health freedom](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), urging Americans to reject blind faith in the medical establishment in favor of informed choice.
This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, September 30, 2025.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Durango 9-R’s Monday update comes as parents dispute the “misinformation” label](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Durango School District 9-R holds its State of the District tonight at the Impact Career Innovation Center. The district’s event page bills it as a community update with test-score dashboards and a Q&A. The Durango Herald said leaders plan to confront “misinformation.” Parent Jason Mietchen hears it differently: “We’ve had to counteract the misinformation for years. The school puts out a ton of it.”
The Herald also referenced Heidi Ganahl’s twelve-part ‘Durango’s 9-R Dirty Dozen,’ a wide-ranging critique of district policy, practice and the outcomes families are talking about. Topics span CMAS proficiency, gender-support steps, the ACA name-change policy, flag resolutions and the government-speech argument, $200,000 in DEI consulting and the 48-count federal indictment of a former teacher on child-exploitation charges. And posts by teachers and a school official in the wake of Charlie Kirk’s assassination.
The notice describes a one-hour program with recent highlights, data transparency, a question period and Spanish interpretation. District leaders say they will show the numbers and take questions. Mietchen pushed back on the celebratory framing: “They made around a two-point increase... we’re still right around 50%.“
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[VSSA teacher apologizes—debate persists over classroom remarks about Charlie Kirk and Trump](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* VSSA teacher Lara Dowling apologized for making inappropriate remarks about Charlie Kirk and Donald Trump after his assassination, calling it a lapse in judgment and emphasizing her opposition to gun violence.
* A student disputed Dowling’s account, claiming she wished Kirk’s death had been Trump’s and told students to keep their beliefs to themselves, leaving some feeling unsafe and unsupported.
* Parents and community leaders remain divided: some demand her removal for dangerous comments, while others argue decades of service should outweigh one mistake; the superintendent says discipline is complete with unpaid leave and training.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Why the Douglas County School Board Election on November 4th Matters More Than Ever](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY ANDY JONES, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Douglas County School District (DCSD) has achieved a dramatic post-COVID turnaround under its conservative-led board, with graduation rates hitting a 15-year high of 92.2% and students earning over $131 million in scholarships.
* Test scores have rebounded strongly, with 63.4% of students proficient or advanced in English language arts—surpassing neighboring districts—and significant gains in math due to targeted interventions.
* As the November 4 election nears, Andy Jones argues that re-electing the “Common Sense” slate of Gambill, Kramer, Smith, and Vail is essential to continue this momentum and preserve Douglas County’s reputation for educational excellence.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
** ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[The Sword of the Spirit: Trailblazing with Common Sense](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | SEPTEMBER 28** _Imagine you’re standing at the edge of a thick, wild forest. The trees tower, the brush is dense, and the way forward looks impossible. Behind you are people who need a path—your family, your friends, maybe even your whole community. Then you notice the weight in your hand._
__
**[Beyond the Rhetoric: Choosing Reason Over Ideology in Colorado’s School Elections](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**BY LAUREEN BOLL | COMMENTARY | SEPTEMBER 26** _If you’re reading this article with ease, consider yourself lucky. According to the National Center for Education Statistics, 28% of adults in the US have low literacy skills, struggling with tasks like understanding complex texts or making inferences. Sadly, that’s a more favorable statistic than what we see in Colorado’s youth. Per the latest Colorado Department of Education statistics, 42% of 11th grade students have low literacy skills._
__

**[Spending Is The Real Underlying Problem](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****
****BY RUSS MINARY | COMMENTARY | SEPTEMBER 25** _This article will put a different and positive perspective on a problem that will eventually bankrupt all of us: SPENDING. Our nation is being slowly consumed by massive unsustainable DEBT. Debt doesn’t happen without spending. Spending is a problem with businesses, government – and many average Americans._
__

subject: The last blue dot in Kansas

body:
I need you to read this
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/94428?t=6&akid=21372%2E878179%2ETXUE0B) Republican politicians want to make it impossible for a Democrat like me to win my district.

Not more difficult. **Impossible.**

This is Congresswoman Sharice Davids from Kansas’ 3rd Congressional district — and Donald Trump has made it his **number one** priority to gerrymander me out of office.

[But team, I didn’t flip this seat from red to blue by running scared when the going got tough, and I’m not going to start now. I’m more energized than ever to defend this seat — and our democracy — from the far-right, but I need you standing with me to do it. Will you split a donation between the Voter Protection Project and my campaign before midnight?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/94428?t=7&akid=21372%2E878179%2ETXUE0B) | [Donate »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/94429?t=8&akid=21372%2E878179%2ETXUE0B)
---
There’s a pretty obvious reason why Donald Trump wants me out of Congress: **I don’t fit his mold of what a “Kansas politician” should look like.**

And friend, he’s right. I do stand out in Washington — and I’m proud of it. I’m the first LGBTQ+ Native American woman ever elected to Congress. I was raised by a single Army mom, paid my own way through college, and even had a career as an MMA fighter before I ran for elected office.

Maybe that background doesn’t make me a “typical” politician. **But I think that’s a good thing.**

But Donald Trump disagrees. Instead, he wants to end _all_ competitive Congressional elections in Kansas and install a hand-picked, far-right extremist in my place.

[Kansas Republicans know they can’t win my district here in Kansas unless they cheat, so they’re trying to stack the deck and pray that we won’t notice. That’s why I need your help. Can you chip in a split donation right away to help me keep fighting back against this partisan power grab while we still have the chance?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/94428?t=9&akid=21372%2E878179%2ETXUE0B)
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Sharice Davids and VPP will go through immediately:

Together, we can win this fight for our democracy’s future. Thank you for having my back.

Sharice

Not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. 401 2nd Ave. S, Ste. 303, Seattle, WA 98104

The Voter Protection Project is on an important mission: To end partisan gerrymandering and voter suppression by electing candidates at the state and federal levels that are forceful advocates for voting rights. Our enfranchisement agenda includes working to ensure that every state has automatic voter registration and online voter registration, convenient early voting, and independent redistricting commissions to ensure politicians are not able to draw their own maps.

Please, consider making a [one-time contribution by clicking here](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/121?t=1&akid=21372%2E878179%2ETXUE0B). **Or, to make the most powerful lasting impact and help us oust Republicans up and down the ballot who attack our right to vote, make a[monthly sustaining contribution by clicking here](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/122?t=2&akid=21372%2E878179%2ETXUE0B).**

Friend — With just hours to go until our FEC filing deadline, I am counting on supporters like YOU today. **Please, read on just a little bit more.**
I announced I was running for reelection back in April, and I was excited to continue advancing this grassroots movement alongside all of you.
But within weeks, AIPAC was already running polls in my district, testing the waters on a corporate-backed, pro-Israel candidate who could challenge me.
So, this FEC deadline isn’t just any deadline. This is our chance to prove to AIPAC, the media, and the entire political establishment that our campaign is stronger than ever. Our chance to prove that it’s not even worth challenging this campaign.
**But with little time left, we are still behind on our fundraising goals.**
And if we fall short, we’ll send the opposite message: that this campaign isn’t as strong as it once was. That this campaign is vulnerable to attacks from AIPAC, Trump, and the entire far-right.
We can’t have that.
**[So please: Chip in $10 or whatever you can afford before my FEC filing deadline hits at midnight. name: Grace (Finance Director)
subject: I just crunched the numbers.
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gw-q3-2025?refcode=em-header [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gw-q3-2025?refcode=em-header]
Hi Peter, Grace here – finance director for George Whitesides’ re-election campaign.

I’m sorry to reach out, but I checked our numbers over my morning cup of coffee, and we’re pacing slightly behind ahead of tonight’s deadline.

This deadline isn’t arbitrary. We’re required by the FEC to make our fundraising public, and everyone from our MAGA challenger to the media will be combing it over for any sign of weakness.

In a race as close as this one, what we raise matters even more . George flipped this seat by a slim margin in November, he’s been named to the Frontline list for the most at-risk Democratic incumbents, and we’re expecting a surge in outside GOP money and attack ads to impact this race at any moment.

Although the midterm elections are over a year away, we’re preparing the groundwork now to win re-election and give Democrats a fighting chance at winning the House majority.

I hope George and I can count on your donation of $3 before the clock strikes midnight. Any amount will fund the voter outreach efforts we need to hold this seat.

Donate >> https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gw-q3-2025?refcode=em-9.30.25-all-a

Thank you,

body:
#
For an administration that has talked about free speech, the First Amendment, “respect for the rule of law” — we are seeing that they are threatening judges, openly talking about punishing Supreme Court Justices, and egregiously indicting members of Congress on baseless allegations.
This is all coming down — not to the facts, not to crime, not to the law — but to political intimidation.
**We will not be intimidated**. We will not be silenced. If they want to come in and arrest every member of Congress, they can come and get us.
But at some point, the Republican-held United States Senate needs to decide what is an impeachable offense.
Because at a certain point, it will not be about Democrats and Republicans — they will start going after Republican Senators who do not do what they want.
We do not have to comply with illegal activity — even if that illegal activity is coming from the President of the United States.

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=rc6qmltxol3cogbt6mtkdil116a87y6x5zkgk9yispahs975j0qqqd95jch8hskhi68fbm88oc63p88mdi8x9us3peojns2qlnyc1n58b1dbd275cvhcghb5xbs3796cplfo92cif90ytwaplltw&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t3f3fk&__onlt=t
