Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t3f3fk&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t3f3fk&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=rc6qmltxol3cogbt6mtkdil116a87y6x5zkgk9yispahs975j0qqqd95jch8hskhi68fbm88oc63p88mdi8x9us3peojns2qlnyc1n58b1dbd275cvhcghb5xbs3796cplfo92cif90ytwaplltw&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t3f3fk&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t3f3fk&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

---
| | Peter –

Today is the day. At midnight tonight, our critical FEC deadline closes, and every contribution will be part of the public record.

If we fall short, Republicans will use that weakness as a roadmap to pour money into San Diego and other competitive districts. If we succeed, we’ll prove that Democrats have the strength and momentum to flip the House next year.

This is about more than one campaign. It’s about building the foundation for a Democratic majority that can:
* Expand affordable health care and lower prescription drug costs
* Confront the climate crisis with urgency
* Defend our democracy from MAGA extremism

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Folks, by all appearances the federal government is heading towards a shutdown starting at 12:01 am tonight.
I have a lot of thoughts, and I wanted to share some of them with you:
1. Government shutdowns are reckless for our economy and the millions of people around the country who rely on government services every day.
2. When Republicans have a triple majority (like now)... they own what happens in Congress!
3. If the GOP needs some Democratic votes to pass a funding bill, they need to offer a funding bill that Democrats will vote for. It’s that simple.
4. Using people’s livelihoods and our national economy as bargaining chips to get Democrats to vote for a very bad bill is cruel and spineless.
5. Holding the federal government hostage to get what you want does not count as governing.
6. Trying to pin a shutdown on Democrats because we wouldn’t cave to irrational, reckless demands does not count as an excuse.
7. Our constituents have been pretty darn clear that as much as no one wants a government shutdown, NO ONE wants Democrats to just capitulate.
8. Trump is the only president in the past 40 years who’s had a government shutdown when his own party controls Congress — and he’s had two of them.
9. It is *painfully* clear that if we want a functional government, we can’t keep letting Republicans win majorities.
That last one is incredibly important. Right now, the balance of power in the House is 213 Democrats (actually 214, but Speaker Johnson refuses to swear in our newest Member – more on that in a future email) to 219 Republicans. Their majority is razor-thin — and incredibly far from a mandate.
In just over a year, we have the chance to take it back, and get some real power to fight bad GOP policies and MAGA extremism. But we need to be ready.
That’s why I’m raising funds right now to help flip the House in 2026. Many campaigns are won or lost well before Election Day, so there’s no time to waste. Will you join me?
Please — pitch in whatever you can today to support my efforts to flip the House next year! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
DONATE $31 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?express_lane=true&amount=31]

DONATE OTHER [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
I really appreciate anything you can give. And if you can’t give today, that’s OK too — thanks for reading and for being on this team.
More updates to come on the shutdown situation and what Democrats are working on.
-Sara

I’m reaching out because what’s happening right now should chill every American to their core.
Trump has set Oregon’s democracy in his sights — and we need to fight back if we want to save our state from his MAGA extremism.
FIRST: He attacked vote-by-mail — the primary way the Oregonians cast their ballots — in an effort to suppress our voting rights and secure more power for himself and his Republicans.

Can I count on you to chip in $10 or more before our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline expires? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=250930em]

If we don’t act now, we risk opening the door to more overreach, more intimidation, and further erosion of civil liberties.
I ran for Secretary of State because I believe in a transparent and accountable government. I believe in Oregon’s vote-by-mail system, which has proven resilient and accessible. And I believe no American should have to fear for their democracy at the hands of the President.
But defending democracy and protecting the right to vote are not free. We need resources to fight back — to push back against this authoritarian drift, to defend Oregon’s institutions, to support election workers, to counter misinformation, and to ensure that every voice is heard. That’s why we have a goal: raise $10,000 in the coming days. Will you stand with me? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=250930em]

Tobias Read

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Once again, the United States is on the verge of a federal government
shutdown.

This time, it’s because Republicans want to cut Medicaid and let
Affordable Care Act subsidies expire at the end of this year, which could
drastically increase health care costs for the 24 million Americans who
have health insurance through the ACA marketplace and kick millions more
off Medicaid entirely.

Donald Trump and the GOP already made the largest cuts to Medicaid,
Medicare, SNAP, and other federal health care programs this summer with
their so-called “One Big Beautiful Bill,” which will gut our care by more
than $1 TRILLION. Now, they’re trying to throw even more working-class
people under the bus again by letting these subsidies expire.

Justice Democrats’ Rep. Summer Lee put it perfectly: “Republicans would
rather shut down the government than extend healthcare tax credits for
working families across the country. This manufactured crisis is
unnecessary and preventable.”

Instead of letting Republicans get their way and force the struggling
working class to pay even more for care that already costs too much,
Democrats must use what little leverage they have and refuse to accept
Republicans’ disastrous agenda.

Justice Democrats are ready to hold the line, but we need Democratic
leadership — including Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer and House
Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries — to do the same.

Back in March, Sen. Schumer caved and voted for the GOP bill, giving up
the little power our Party had and enabling it to pass. We can’t let that
happen again.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/em20250925-signup-shutdown/?source=em20250930-37067&akid=37067%2E1203867%2EgzGbG5 ]Add your name to our urgent petition urging Schumer, Jeffries, and
Democrats at large to stand strong and oppose Republicans’ harmful
spending bill!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/em20250925-signup-shutdown/?source=em20250930-37067&akid=37067%2E1203867%2EgzGbG5 ]Add Your Name

Republicans will be responsible for the millions of federal workers who
won’t receive paychecks and the hundreds of thousands who could be
furloughed—all because they’re desperate to take healthcare away from
working families.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. Hi friend, it’s Nikki here.

I want to extend my gratitude ahead of tonight’s end-of-quarter deadline – I know you’ve heard a lot from me and my team lately, so this is the last time I’m reaching out.

I just got off the phone with my finance director, Nadav, and he told me that we’re close to hitting our goal before the FEC deadline expires.

But before I ask you to **[chip in $3](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/116278131/573051773/-550958566?refcode=em-9.30.25-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZDNmMzM2Yy00MDllLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8xH6lIChUjmtF_xyXXb4BldYgSGNLxUrfM5H6gU3zyE=)** , I need to explain why this matters.

I know it seems early, and that there’s a lot of time before the midterm elections next year. That is true, but we’re also facing unprecedented challenges in this race:

I have two Republican opponents who are courting the GOP machine to unseat me and become nothing more than a rubber stamp for the MAGA agenda. We’ve also faced early attacks from the NRCC because I’m not bowing to these far-right forces.

My main concern is doing right by Central and Southern Illinois. I’m putting my head down and finding a way to actually deliver results. It’s what I’ve done since flipping this seat in 2022, and not even a Republican majority can stop me.

It hasn’t been easy, and as we move closer to the election year, the national GOP is making it known that this seat is on their shortlist to turn red.

That’s what makes your support today so critical: After this deadline, our fundraising becomes public. We need a strong showing to prove that we aren’t going anywhere – and we won’t allow working families to be punished by this administration’s billionaire agenda.

If you’re with me, a donation of $3 or any amount would truly go a long way today. Will you chip in to stand with me in defense of IL-13 and our democracy?

Remember the SAVE Act, Peter? I know how hard it is to keep track of everything these days, so here’s a refresher: It’s the extreme anti-democracy bill that passed the House earlier this year but got blocked by the Senate after a public outcry. This bill would be a cudgel to voting rights, and would likely disenfranchise millions of people, including women, younger voters, naturalized citizens, and low-income voters. Now, some extreme lawmakers are trying to sneak the bill through the Senate by attaching the SAVE Act to a budget resolution or the National Defense Authorization Act — essentially, slipping it through alongside essential legislation, hoping no one will notice. [**These are the types of fights the NDRC was made for. Help us push back on all attempts to take power away from voters — whether it’s in Congress or the states.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/116278331/573052456/1110433579?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_MAGASaveActNOR_email_20250930-NDRC-Tier1-MAGASaveActNOR_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20250930-NDRC-Tier1-MAGASaveActNOR_&utm_campaign=MAGASaveActNOR&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjcxM2YzMzZjLTQwOWUtZjAxMS04ZTYxLTYwNDViZGVkOGJhNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Co-lWHjisg4_hl36Fc12UVAoh37uetvbV1AA0gZE250=) | _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_

The SAVE Act would require all American citizens registering to vote or updating their registration to present proof of citizenship — either a passport or a birth certificate. Government-issued driver’s licenses wouldn’t work, putting the onus on each individual voter to prove that they’re American citizens.
And if your information doesn’t match what’s on your birth certificate — say you changed your last name after getting married, like 84 percent of married women, for example — then you might not be able to vote. Or say you lost your birth certificate in a move or a house fire? Too bad.
Bottom line: The SAVE Act would turn voting rights upside-down and disenfranchise millions of Americans. And that’s the whole idea — Republicans these days are terrified of the will of the people. That’s why we exist: to fight for people’s rights to be heard. Right now, we’ve got to pull out all the stops to prevent this bill from ever passing the Senate.

clean_body: We won’t let them get away with this sneak attack on our right to vote. | Remember the SAVE Act, Peter? I know how hard it is to keep track of everything these days, so here’s a refresher: It’s the extreme anti-democracy bill that passed the House earlier this year but got blocked by the Senate after a public outcry. This bill would be a cudgel to voting rights, and would likely disenfranchise millions of people, including women, younger voters, naturalized citizens, and low-income voters. Now, some extreme lawmakers are trying to sneak the bill through the Senate by attaching the SAVE Act to a budget resolution or the National Defense Authorization Act — essentially, slipping it through alongside essential legislation, hoping no one will notice. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = The SAVE Act would require all American citizens registering to vote or updating their registration to present proof of citizenship — either a passport or a birth certificate. Government-issued driver’s licenses wouldn’t work, putting the onus on each individual voter to prove that they’re American citizens. And if your information doesn’t match what’s on your birth certificate — say you changed your last name after getting married, like 84 percent of married women, for example — then you might not be able to vote. Or say you lost your birth certificate in a move or a house fire? Too bad. Bottom line: The SAVE Act would turn voting rights upside-down and disenfranchise millions of Americans. And that’s the whole idea — Republicans these days are terrified of the will of the people. That’s why we exist: to fight for people’s rights to be heard. Right now, we’ve got to pull out all the stops to prevent this bill from ever passing the Senate. = Thank you, Brianna Shamsuddoha, Director of Mobilization National Democratic Redistricting Committee = = Since 2017, the NDRC has executed a comprehensive redistricting strategy that shifts the redistricting power, creating fair districts where Democrats can compete. Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
The movement to end the Electoral College is making progress, friend: Minnesota and Maine are just the latest states to join the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact.
If you don't remember -- The National Popular Vote Interstate Compact (NPVIC) is an agreement among a group of U.S. states and the District of Columbia to award all their electoral votes to whichever presidential candidate wins the overall popular vote in the 50 states and the District of Columbia. 17 states plus DC have now joined.
Minnesota brought 10 electoral votes, and Maine 4, now accounting for 209 Electoral College votes of the 270 needed to win the election and totaling 78% of what is needed to effectively make the popular vote the law of the land. Minnesota passed a slate of voting rights protections alongside joining the compact as well, which represents huge progress.
Whether it's through the NPVIC or one of the other legal alternatives, ending the Electoral College forever is a big priority.
We are going to make this happen! Keep the momentum going and put us over the top so we can end the Electoral College forever with $25 or more today! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-end-electoral-college?refcode=093025_3&amount=25]

The Electoral College is the biggest tool that opponents of voting rights have to swing national elections and suppress the will of the people. We have to take away this dangerous mechanism that enabled the January 6th insurrection by any means necessary.

I stand by those words, which puts a target on my back.

---

### We don’t have billionaire donors. But we have something better: **YOU

Veteran. Fighter. Servant of the people.**

name: The Antimonopolist
subject: How to decide who to support
body:
People often ask where to give money, and I always find it hard to answer. For me, the real test is whether someone has actually stood up to corporate power when it was risky to do so, not when it was safe or symbolic. That test narrows the field pretty quickly, but David Seligman clears it without question. He's an underdog running for Colorado Attorney General right now. He spent years as a public interest lawyer challenging Uber and Lyft as they built their business model around classifying | | | | [](https://the-antimonopolist.ghost.io/r/b25799ad?m=46b412a0-1cbe-4fcb-b85d-2477ce9f4e21)

Seligman testifying (probably against Uber)
| | | People often ask where to give money, and I always find it hard to answer. For me, the real test is whether someone has actually stood up to corporate power when it was risky to do so, not when it was safe or symbolic. That test narrows the field pretty quickly, but David Seligman clears it without question.He's an underdog running for Colorado Attorney General right now. He spent years as a public interest lawyer challenging Uber and Lyft as they built their business model around classifying drivers as "independent contractors," a legal trick that allowed them to avoid paying unemployment insurance, providing sick leave, or guaranteeing even the minimum wage. Most politicians were still celebrating "innovation" in the gig economy, but David was in court, fighting to make sure those drivers weren't stripped of basic protections.He also helped lead the fight against payday lenders in Colorado, who were charging desperate families annual interest rates well over 200 percent. The industry poured millions into defeating a ballot initiative to cap rates at 36 percent. With David's legal and strategic work, voters overwhelmingly sided against the lenders, and families across the state were spared from being trapped in endless cycles of debt.[He's got powerful opponents. Any support helps. ](https://the-antimonopolist.ghost.io/r/39318216?m=46b412a0-1cbe-4fcb-b85d-2477ce9f4e21)And he has consistently taken on wage theft in restaurants, on construction sites, and in other workplaces where corporations quietly rob workers of the money they've earned, often assuming nobody will fight them. David has made a career out of clawing that money back and proving that the law can, in fact, work for ordinary people.This is why the office of Attorney General is so critical right now. Attorneys General don't just issue statements; they have real power to block mergers, to sue monopolies, to regulate contracts, and to reshape markets that determine how much people pay for food, housing, or health care. We already have plenty of Attorneys General who are eager to put out press releases about standing up to Trump. What we don't have enough of are Attorneys General who are willing to stand up to Wall Street, Silicon Valley, and the everyday corporate abuses that quietly shape the lives of millions.[Give $5 or $50, it all helps!](https://the-antimonopolist.ghost.io/r/d81b44c7?m=46b412a0-1cbe-4fcb-b85d-2477ce9f4e21) David Seligman has already shown he will take those fights on when it's lonely, when it's hard, and when the odds are against him. That's the kind of record that makes me believe he's worth supporting. If you're trying to decide where to put your money, consider sending a little his way.[Give your beer money to a real hell raiser today! ](https://the-antimonopolist.ghost.io/r/4df2eabb?m=46b412a0-1cbe-4fcb-b85d-2477ce9f4e21)More soon,Zephyr PS: Mamdani is going to be the next Mayor of New York. Buckle your seatbelts for the attacks!

clean_body: Hey Peter, it's Wesley. I know your inbox is flooded with fundraising emails right now. I promise this one's different. = Every Sunday, my family gets together for Game Night — it's something we've been doing for years. We cook, we laugh, and we compete. And let me tell you: We are competitive. If you walked in on one of our games, you might think we don't even like each other. Voices get raised, trash gets talked, and nobody gives an inch. But underneath all that, it's love. We're a close bunch — we just don't like losing. If I've learned something over the years after countless family game nights, it's this: If someone knows they're about to lose, they're more likely to bend the rules. That's exactly what the GOP is doing right now. They see the writing on the wall, and they know that Donald Trump's extreme and unpopular agenda is alienating voters and tanking their entire image. National Republicans are trying to redraw Missouri's maps to silence voices and cheat their way into power. They're holding our federal government's budget hostage to push through unpopular cuts to Medicaid and careening us toward another government shutdown. Trump's games are infuriating and damaging. But here's the truth: It's the American people who hold the cards. We can hold crooked politicians accountable if we start laying the groundwork now to build Democratic power in Missouri and across the country ahead of the 2026 midterms. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | | = | | = ---|---|---|---|--- = | | = | | = ---|---|---|---|--- Thanks for always having my back, Wesley = = PAID FOR BY BELL FOR MISSOURI PO Box 190669, ST LOUIS, MO 63119

name: Jazz Lewis
subject: Looking forward to seeing you on October 29!
body:
https://www.jazzlewis.com/ [https://www.jazzlewis.com/]
Hi Friend,
I hope you’ll join me for my Fall Reception [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jazz251029?refcode=email_250930_largo_blast#2] on Wednesday, October 29, 2025 , from 5:30–7:30 PM at the Largo Homewood Suites in the Piscataway Room.
This will be a wonderful opportunity to connect, share updates on my priorities, discuss what our community needs to thrive, and explore how we can work together to create real, meaningful change. It has been a true blessing to serve District 24 , and I would be honored to have you join me for an evening celebrating our progress.
If you can join me, or would like to make a contribution , you can get tickets and learn more at bit.ly/JazzOct29 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jazz251029?refcode=email_250930_largo_blast#2] . However, if you prefer to pay by check , they can be made payable to:

17 W. Courtland St. Suite 210,
Bel Air, MD 21014
If you have any questions, contact Rice Consulting at 410-838-6355 or email jazzlewis@riceconsultingllc.com [jazzlewis@riceconsultingllc.com] .
As always, I appreciate your support in this re-election campaign.
See you there,
Jazz

Friend, before I tell you about tonight's End of Quarter Fundraising Deadline, and how important it is to our campaign, I wanted to say something.
But if you only have a minute, please donate what you can to help us raise the $6,459 more we need to raise before our numbers go public—any amount helps. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hall-email?refcode=20250930_em_fr_b2_HH_BIG]
DONATE BEFORE OUR DEADLINE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hall-email?refcode=20250930_em_fr_b2_HH_BIG]
Friend, my parents didn't grow up wealthy. Before joining the Army and serving overseas, my father picked oranges and raised cattle, and as a teenager, my mother escaped post-war Germany and settled in the Bay Area to work in childcare.
They worked hard to provide for our family and taught me so much about dedication and perseverance. But because we weren't well-off, it was the kitchen table issues that they constantly had to think about.
When I moved to Grass Valley to raise my two boys, I did so as a single mom. I was looking for a place that was outside the city and also more affordable. And just like my parents, I found myself constantly thinking about the kitchen table issues and the future I would be able to give my family.
While our opponent plays partisan political games, I'm reaching out to say that we have more in common than people like him want to admit.
The kitchen table issues—rent, wages, inflation, and safety—are things that we all think about. And creating a better future is a priority that we all have.
That's why I'm running for Congress, to get rid of the toxic D.C. politics that seek to divide us and deliver on the kitchen table issues that affect us all. Reaching our End of Quarter goal will help us get there, and I need your support to raise $6,459 before our midnight deadline. Friend, can you please chip in? Heidi Hall
Heidi Hall has spent her three-decade public service career working with others to solve problems, protect our land and water, improve health, and build opportunities for others, all while raising two boys primarily as a single mom.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hall-email?refcode=20250930_em_fr_b2_HH_BIG [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hall-email?refcode=20250930_em_fr_b2_HH_BIG]
Raised by parents who had persisted to make a middle-class life for their kids in Contra Costa County while lifting up others, Heidi was taught to push through and overcome challenges rather than complain about them. She learned to stick up for the vulnerable, to respect working people, and to value equal opportunity and justice.
After graduating from Pomona College and earning graduate degrees from Columbia and Rutgers, Heidi went to work for the Rockefeller Foundation promoting reproductive care and then began her career at the Environmental Protection Agency, stopping the dumping of toxic waste and holding corporate polluters accountable.
Today, Heidi chairs the Nevada County Board of Supervisors, where she’s taken on homelessness, expanded broadband access, and worked to reduce crime and illegal cannabis growth. Heidi flipped her seat from red to blue – and now she’s ready to do it again in Congress to take on toxic politics in Washington and put people first.

| | | | Peter, When I first ran for office, I promised to do more than just talk about problems. I wanted to be part of the solution. That’s why I worked to bring a healthcare facility to an under served area in our community – because I believe every Tennessean deserves the chance to see a doctor when they’re sick. Not everyone agreed it could be done, but I fought for it, and we got it across the finish line. **The truth is, everything I do comes down to four basic things:**
* Making sure families have enough money to put food on the table.
* Making sure people can pay their bills.
* Making sure every family has a roof over their head.
* Making sure that when people get sick, they can see a doctor.

That’s the standard I hold myself to. And that’s the standard I’ll bring to Congress. **But right now, we’re still about $10,000 short of our end-of-quarter goal, and if we don’t close the gap by midnight TONIGHT, our ads go dark.** That would make it harder to reach the very voters we need to flip this seat for working families. **[I don’t waste time whining and complaining, y’all. # Hillary Clinton torn apart for remarks about "white men of a certain religion" damaging America
Hillary Clinton stated on MSNBC's "Morning Joe" that "white men of a certain persuasion, a certain religion, a certain point of view, a certain ideology" are "doing such damage" to what America should be aiming for, suggesting some want to "turn the clock back" on equality.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/30fef293-71c1-4a3c-83c9-712a4cb05d45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Backlash over timing** : Critics accused Clinton of being "tone-deaf" and spreading "evil" by making these remarks just two weeks after Charlie Kirk's assassination on September 10, with social media users arguing she was "encouraging what happened" and making "yet another case for violence against white Christian men."
* **Accusations of divisiveness** : Social media responses condemned Clinton for "dehumanizing and dangerous" rhetoric against "huge segments of the population," with her focus on Christianity described as "chilling," while others questioned whether her comments suggested some Americans' contributions are "more welcome than others."
* **Heritage Foundation response** : Roger Severino, the Heritage Foundation's vice president of domestic policy, called Clinton's comments "beyond tone-deaf" during the nation's mourning period and said they confirmed she still believes "millions of Americans belong in her 'basket of deplorables' based on their sex, race, and sincere religious beliefs."

While families prayed, they scoffed. While conservatives came together, they shrugged. Crockett thinks words like “Hitler” are just political seasoning. But she knows exactly what she’s doing. I recorded this message for you as we face the last few hours before Republicans shut the government down.

Emily Randall for Congress
Peter, I recorded this message for you as we face the last few hours before Republicans shut the government down: [_**https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9BYvpSZmd18**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/116284127/573067588/-803653937?v=9BYvpSZmd18&refcode=RS_EM_FR_2025.09.30_Shutdown_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNzg1Nzc5MC00YTllLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KTjgFnGxZseQcNx0uy44FF2CysdL1coUWdMnuFfcIik=&emci=c56f49e5-419e-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=b7857790-4a9e-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=23483442)
Federal workers at PSNS and Olympic National Park, Social Security Offices, the VA, Forest Services, NOAA, and many others will be impacted.
We know what furloughs mean for our families. But we also know that _**all of us**_ are facing skyrocketing healthcare premiums, rural hospitals at risk, Medicaid being ripped away from disabled Americans, nursing home coverage lost — and all because Republicans prefer to give tax breaks to billionaires and big corporations instead of showing up for regular people.

| | Dear Friends, It’s been a busy and inspiring few weeks, and I’m excited to share some highlights with you:
**👮 Honoring Women in Blue**
I recently attended a [Phoenix Police Foundatio](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=4d4a27c9fd&e=a7ab36849c)n lunch recognizing three incredible women in the Phoenix Police Department. If you’d like to support the “[Women in Blue](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=5a96d5e446&e=a7ab36849c),” the Foundation is a great nonprofit doing meaningful work for law enforcement.
**⚖️ Justice Court Visit**
I had the opportunity to shadow a Justice of the Peace in our legislative district, observing cases from landlord-tenant disputes to orders of protection. As a member of the Senate Committee on Judiciary, it’s invaluable to see how our [justice ](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=bcc4342a1c&e=a7ab36849c)[courts](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=1de9273fb5&e=a7ab36849c) operate and serve our communities.
**📚 Civil Access to Justice**
I joined a CivEx Zoom hosted by the Flinn Foundation with leaders from the [Arizona Commission on Access to Justice](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=002c7c7307&e=a7ab36849c). Arizona continues to innovate in making judicial resources accessible, especially for self-represented litigants in both rural and urban areas.
**🏢 Business Engagement**
[Plexus Worldwide](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=f0bdf54e58&e=a7ab36849c) welcomed elected officials at all levels of government to learn about their mission in gut health and community giving. As Chairman of the Senate Committee on Regulatory Affairs and Government Efficiency, I appreciated the chance to discuss reducing red tape and improving business relations with the state.
**📜 Legislative Update**
September 26 marked 90 days since Sine Die—meaning all bills signed into law this session are now in effect, including [15 bills](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=b4f079c646&e=a7ab36849c) I sponsored. I’m already drafting legislation for the upcoming session.
**🎗️ Community Events**
On Saturday morning, I participated in the inaugural [**2025 Moon Valley MILE**](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=8f6041a81a&e=a7ab36849c) , benefiting Phoenix Children’s Hospital and the [Jaydie Lynn King Foundation](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=8eda639877&e=a7ab36849c). It was a moving event supporting pediatric cancer patients along with support from Shadow Mountain High School’s JROTC/Space Force and music by Pandy Raye. Many kudos to Paul Ruckel for organizing and shepherding such a terrific charitable event supporting such a worthwhile cause we can all get behind.

Later in the day, I visited the Phoenix Children’s Museum for the [**Defenders of Children**](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=9a938ba069&e=a7ab36849c) , supporting legal assistance for vulnerable children—a cause I’ve championed through legislation.
**🌧️ Weather Watch**
I hope everyone stayed safe during last week’s intense thunderstorms. Arizona isn’t built for heavy rainfall, especially here in the Valley.

📰 **Bolick in the News**
New Animal Cruelty Law - [KTAR](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=504a66dd6a&e=a7ab36849c)[ News](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=d603bf3d04&e=a7ab36849c) and [Arizona Capitol Times](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=016c60c090&e=a7ab36849c)
---
| **Campaign Update

🗓️ Upcoming Campaign Kick-off Fundraiser**
Join me on **October 22nd from 4pm to 6pm** in **downtown Phoenix** for a joint campaign fundraiser with Rep. Walt Blackman. I need to start raising money for our 2026 election, and I hope you will continue to support my efforts.
📩 [Please RSVP](mailto:info@bolickforarizona.com?subject=RSVP%20for%2010%2F22) to receive the address.

🗳️** Please help me get my name on the 2026 Republican primary ballot**
As many of you may know, I was involved in a car accident at the end of June. I’ve spent the past few months focusing on healing, and I’m grateful for the continued support as I move forward. _Now, I’m turning my attention back to serving our community—and I need your help._ If you reside in the following zip codes, there is a good chance I represent you at the state capitol: 85022, 85023, 85024, 85027, 85029, 85032, 85050, 85053, 85085, 85308, 85310, or 85331.

What I don't often get asked now that I'm an elected official is why I do what I do — even when it's hard.= | | = My why is the people of Pennsylvania, it's that simple. My why is the hard-working people I grew up with in Mon Valley — factory workers, teachers, who are the lifeblood of our state. My why is my mom and dad, a hairdresser and a union bus driver. I watched them juggle bills, put food on the table, and raise a family. My why is my wife, Blayre, and my daughter Harper, who both deserve access to reproductive healthcare and bodily autonomy. Knowing my why is what gets me up in the morning and what motivates me to fight for the people of Pennsylvania every day. Maybe your why is like mine. You're worried about your parents' social security or your neighbor's Medicare. You care about people. When I first decided to run for City Council years ago, it was after a patient of mine told me he was about to lose his job and his healthcare.

Friend,
I wrote to you yesterday about the [most important fundraising deadline](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=cb73604805&e=606d7e9aa2) of our campaign. I’m reaching out one last time today because we have just hours left to hit our goal.
**Our report is due at midnight tonight** , and it will send a powerful signal across Virginia about whether we have the grassroots strength to win this fight.
When I first decided to run for City Council years ago, it was after a patient of mine, a longtime worker at the Dan River Mills, told me he was about to **lose his job and his healthcare**. That conversation has always stuck with me.
Today, the choice is simple: will we elect leaders who **stand up for working families** , or will we let an extreme agenda **gut our local hospitals, defund our schools** , and leave our neighbors behind?
This is our moment to show that we are ready to fight for the future of our Commonwealth. What we show on our fundraising report tonight **will determine the resources** and support we get for the rest of this race.
**So I'm asking you personally: can you please chip in before our final deadline at midnight?**
[**[Chip in $25 now]**](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=86419791cc&e=606d7e9aa2)[**[Chip in $50 now]**](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=be6191b41f&e=606d7e9aa2)[**[Chip in $100 now]**](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=b4c3ff2d9a&e=606d7e9aa2)[**[Or chip in any amount]**](https://drmillerforyou.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=db0c834d5d03c9893fbbb1d8a&id=4d760dddff&e=606d7e9aa2)
Every single dollar makes a difference. Thank you for being a part of this.
With gratitude,
Dr. Gary MillerCandidate for House of Delegates District 49

[Give Me 20% Off!](https://substack.com/redirect/4b4997b3-e0e4-4d01-96ba-45382fe82a91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
It is a sad but unsurprising fact that in these degenerate times under Trump, [almost any federal government office may be filled with clownish impostors](https://substack.com/redirect/4b4997b3-e0e4-4d01-96ba-45382fe82a91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
And nowhere is this more nakedly on display than in the halls of justice now being defiled by Lindsey Halligan, the latest hand-picked stooge of the Banana Republican-in-Chief.
Ms. Halligan, a 36-year-old former Colorado beauty queen and now, miraculously, the U.S. Attorney for the Eastern District of Virginia, seems to have confused the federal bench with a pageant stage. More on that in a moment.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4b4997b3-e0e4-4d01-96ba-45382fe82a91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
A few weeks ago on Newsmax, Halligan spoke about the Trump White House assault on the Smithsonian.
She boldly declared, "I think, uh, it should reflect, uh, the values of the American people, instead of pushing ideology that over, uh, Americans overwhelmingly uh, do not support, and uh."
Halligan would have served herself better to state a Miss Congeniality cliche, "world peace."
Yet now, Halligan has turned her beauty queen syntax and blank gaze to something more ambitious: the criminal prosecution of a former FBI Director.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4b4997b3-e0e4-4d01-96ba-45382fe82a91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
James Comey--the man who gave the world both Hillary Clinton's October Surprise and Donald Trump's swan dive into legal hell--is now the target of a Halligan's prosecution.
A case so threadbare, so sloppily constructed, and so legally bankrupt, it makes the Salem witch trials look like a model of judicial restraint. The indictment Halligan cobbled together is [a symphony of both farce and incompetence](https://substack.com/redirect/82811119-89b8-4faa-aa7e-245d2f4ad9d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Presented to a grand jury (over the objections of every career-line prosecutor in Halligan's office), the case was so shaky it couldn't even secure a unanimous return on all counts.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.FcVg0nJJefdpbvvHTsY__noDsumLZ2X1vETSaTx2mB4?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=174865415)
Then came the real comedy.
The filing of two separate charging documents. One stating that the grand jury indicted Comey on two counts and refused a third, and another stating they refused all three.
When confronted by a federal judge, who judging by the transcript seemed torn between confusion and contempt, Halligan offered a series of increasingly incoherent answers:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4b4997b3-e0e4-4d01-96ba-45382fe82a91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
She hadn't seen the contradictory filing, she said. Didn't sign it. Didn't know where it came from.
Then the judge pointed out, ever so politely, that her signature was on the very document she disclaimed. Ms. Halligan responded the way any third-rate intern might when caught forging a time sheet: "Okay, well..."
Let it be noted, correctly submitting grand jury paperwork is not rocket science. It is not even law school material.
It is the sort of procedural bread-and-butter that even the greenest assistant U.S. attorney handles with the sleepy confidence of a DMV clerk.
Yet here we have the top federal prosecutor serving in one of the most important jurisdictions in the nation, standing before a judge like a game-show contestant who buzzed in without knowing the answer.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4b4997b3-e0e4-4d01-96ba-45382fe82a91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And all of it--the bungled indictment, the legal fictions, the disregard for professional standards--serves [a single tawdry purpose. Appeasing the orange idol](https://substack.com/redirect/393843ac-0a2d-4d05-9b02-3c499138b5ad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) who appointed her.
Trump, still raging over Comey's perceived betrayal, needed a scalp. [What he got instead is a flaming embarrassment](https://substack.com/redirect/f9289e29-a860-4e4f-a434-0f1cd7476aa7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
He has a prosecutor no one respects, launching a case no one believes in, with evidence no one has seen.
Even Fox News legal analyst Andrew McCarthy is calling Halligan's prosecution unserious, a tissue of conjecture and fantasy unfit for courtroom air.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4b4997b3-e0e4-4d01-96ba-45382fe82a91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
He says the case should be dismissed outright, but that it won't be. Because, in his words, the judge may be too afraid of the political blowback and threats that would follow a public rejection of Trump's latest fever dream.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.FcVg0nJJefdpbvvHTsY__noDsumLZ2X1vETSaTx2mB4?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=174865415)
[That's where we are as a society at this moment. Let that sink in. ](https://substack.com/redirect/4b4997b3-e0e4-4d01-96ba-45382fe82a91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
A federal judge might let this mockery of justice stumble its way to trial _not because it has merit._
But because the Judge fears the torch-wielding MAGA hordes that follow Donald Trump. The ones who act like he's the second coming of Andrew Jackson...with a social media account.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4b4997b3-e0e4-4d01-96ba-45382fe82a91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
There was a time in this country when U.S. Attorneys were serious men and women--prosecutors with iron stomachs and sharp minds who revered the law more than party loyalty.
Ms. Halligan, in contrast, [appears to believe her job is to manufacture crimes as personal favors for her political benefactor](https://substack.com/redirect/79482dc6-b51c-4b68-a861-a88619cc19df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). She is a prosecutor in title only.
In reality Halligan's a glorified PR stunt in heels and hairspray busy fumbling through one of the most consequential federal prosecutions in recent memory. Like a tourist lost in a law library.
And yet, I find myself perversely hoping the case _does_ go to trial.
Not because I think Comey is guilty--the record shows quite the opposite -- but because the public deserves to see the Trump Justice Department publicly humiliated.
James Comey's defense attorney is former special counsel Patrick Fitzgerald.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4b4997b3-e0e4-4d01-96ba-45382fe82a91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Years ago, in the CIA leak/Plame-gate investigation, Fitzgerald got convictions against Dick Cheney's chief of staff Scooter Libby. I witnessed those proceedings.
Fitzgerald is as strong and skilled a courtroom advocate as you will ever find. And he will be going against...Lindsey Halligan.
Even if Halligan had any evidence against Comey, hadn't gotten his Congressional testimony wrong, and could leverage even a modicum of courtroom experience, she would get eviscerated.
So, I say let a jury of twelve citizens, armed with nothing but common sense and contempt for government overreach, deliver the resounding acquittal that will shame this travesty into the annals of failed political vendettas.
When the verdict is read, Comey will be exonerated, Halligan's name will become a punchline whispered in DOJ elevators and across D.C. cocktail parties.
Then perhaps we will remember that in American politics, as in life, the most dangerous thing you can give a fool, like Trump, is power.
[And the second most dangerous is a pen.](https://substack.com/redirect/4b4997b3-e0e4-4d01-96ba-45382fe82a91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Let Halligan keep talking. Let Trump keep scheming. Let the transcripts keep coming.
This is no longer a legal proceeding--it is an absurd and putrid farce. And we are all sitting ringside, watching the Trump circus cannibalize itself.

Even Fox News legal analyst Andrew McCarthy is calling Halligan's prosecution unserious, a tissue of conjecture and fantasy unfit for courtroom air. | | ---|---|--- He says the case should be dismissed outright, but that it won't be. Because, in his words, the judge may be too afraid of the political blowback and threats that would follow a public rejection of Trump's latest fever dream. A federal judge might let this mockery of justice stumble its way to trial not because it has merit. But because the Judge fears the torch-wielding MAGA hordes that follow Donald Trump. The ones who act like he's the second coming of Andrew Jackson...with a social media account. | | ---|---|--- There was a time in this country when U.S. Attorneys were serious men and women--prosecutors with iron stomachs and sharp minds who revered the law more than party loyalty. Ms. Halligan, in contrast, . She is a prosecutor in title only. In reality Halligan's a glorified PR stunt in heels and hairspray busy fumbling through one of the most consequential federal prosecutions in recent memory. Like a tourist lost in a law library. And yet, I find myself perversely hoping the case does go to trial. Not because I think Comey is guilty--the record shows quite the opposite -- but because the public deserves to see the Trump Justice Department publicly humiliated. James Comey's defense attorney is former special counsel Patrick Fitzgerald. | | ---|---|--- Years ago, in the CIA leak/Plame-gate investigation, Fitzgerald got convictions against Dick Cheney's chief of staff Scooter Libby. I witnessed those proceedings. Fitzgerald is as strong and skilled a courtroom advocate as you will ever find. And he will be going against...Lindsey Halligan. Even if Halligan had any evidence against Comey, hadn't gotten his Congressional testimony wrong, and could leverage even a modicum of courtroom experience, she would get eviscerated. So, I say let a jury of twelve citizens, armed with nothing but common sense and contempt for government overreach, deliver the resounding acquittal that will shame this travesty into the annals of failed political vendettas. When the verdict is read, Comey will be exonerated, Halligan's name will become a punchline whispered in DOJ elevators and across D.C. cocktail parties. Then perhaps we will remember that in American politics, as in life, the most dangerous thing you can give a fool, like Trump, is power. Let Halligan keep talking. Let Trump keep scheming. Let the transcripts keep coming. This is no longer a legal proceeding--it is an absurd and putrid farce. And we are all sitting ringside, watching the Trump circus cannibalize itself. * You're currently a free subscriber to . name: Kristen McDonald Rivet
subject: The horrific shooting in Grand Blanc
body:
|
#
Friend, I’ve spent the past two days in Grand Blanc with families, community members, and local leaders as we process the tragedy that has shaken the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints and the entire nation. I wanted to share some reflections. First, my heart is with the victims and their families. It’s clear that this grief isn’t theirs to carry alone – the whole community is mourning alongside them. In the midst of that grief, there have been moments of hope. The response from first responders – police, fire, EMTs, and hospital staff – was swift, courageous, and lifesaving. Their heroism has been a light for all of us in this painful time. But healing is not going to happen overnight. This loss is too deep. Right now, we must hold one another close, supporting those who are hurting and letting our neighbors know they’re not alone. Today through Friday, counselors and other services will be available from 8 AM until 8 PM. Today (September 30th), counselors will be at the Genesys Banquet and Conference Center (805 Health Park Blvd, Grand Blanc, MI 48439) for victims, family members, and any community member in need. October 1st through October 3rd counselors will be at the Grand Blanc Senior Center (12632 Pagels Dr, Grand Blanc, MI 48439). And if you or someone you know needs immediate support, you can also reach the Red Cross at 248-705-7352. In the days ahead, we’ll begin the difficult work of addressing hard questions. What is our path forward? How do we stop this cycle of violence that has touched far too many communities in Michigan and across the country? And what can we do – together – to build a future where families don’t have to live with this kind of fear? I don’t pretend to have all the answers. But I know this: Grand Blanc is strong. I’ve seen it in the faces of the first responders who acted without hesitation, in the neighbors who are showing up for each other, and in the quiet resilience of families beginning the long road to healing. Take care, Kristen
---

subject: Here’s the kicker, Peter
body:
Peter,
I’m glad I could catch you tonight. I know we have been in touch quite a bit this week, so I’ll get right to the point.
Midnight marks my FEC fundraising deadline, where my team and I are working hard to send a strong message about what our campaign is made of.
As it stands, we’re about $3,146 short of our quarterly goal. With just a few more grassroots contributions, we’ll be able to show real strength on this report.
I’d be remiss if I didn’t ask one last time: will you make a last-minute donation before midnight to help us reach our goal? Yours could be the one that puts us over the hump.
Here’s a good link: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/es-q3-2025](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/116290827/573077496/896231865?refcode=em-9.30.25-all-3-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZDBiOGY5YS01MDllLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WOspbUW9RKUc1fHeLxBrlwSRyHsviANvl5OoNHcoHwI=)**
I have never lost sight of the fact that being in Congress isn’t about politics – it is about helping out my neighbors every day.
Unfortunately, it's clear that this brand of MAGA Republicans, from the White House to the Speaker of the House, have little interest in passing legislation – or governing in a democratic fashion at all, really. They’ve forced us to the brink of a government shutdown despite having full control of all three branches of government.
It truly is shameless, Peter.
And here’s the kicker: shutdown or not, the GOP is still recruiting candidates to try to take this seat. Because they don’t care about improving lives, only gaining total control of ours.
The _best_ way we can push back on their dangerous agenda is by relegating them back into the minority. And there are very few pathways to winning back the House without keeping Illinois’ 17th District blue.
So Peter, will you send a strong message that we’re well-prepared to defend this seat? Here’s that link one more time: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/es-q3-2025**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/116290828/573077497/896231865?refcode=em-9.30.25-all-3-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZDBiOGY5YS01MDllLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WOspbUW9RKUc1fHeLxBrlwSRyHsviANvl5OoNHcoHwI=)
Thank you in advance, and here’s to ending this nightmare.
-Eric

clean_body: I wouldn’t email you if it wasn’t absolutely necessary. | I've spent decades in the fight for justice, from protesting for women’s rights to getting arrested on the Capitol steps for climate action. So trust me when I say this: I wouldn't be writing to you this late if I didn't believe we have a real shot at turning the tide in the fight for our climate. Right now, our endorsed climate champions in nearly a dozen states, from Virginia to Georgia, Pennsylvania, and beyond, are fighting to win critical races in November against opponents backed by Big Oil's endless money. We recently proved what's possible with Adelita Grijalva, our endorsed candidate in Arizona, who just became the state’s first Latina elected to Congress. These elections are our first major test since Trump's return to power, and our chance to prove that his dirty fossil fuel agenda won't go unchallenged. = | = Our endorsed candidates aren't asking for millions. They're not asking to compete with Big Oil dollar for dollar. They just need enough resources to reach the voters who care about the climate crisis. Your $10 or $20 donation, along with thousands of other small donations, builds real grassroots power. Your support strengthens our ability to compete when Big Oil tries to buy elections, and it could be the difference between a climate champion winning or losing by a handful of votes. I know there are a thousand other things you could spend your money on. I know this email is probably one of dozens you've received today. Hey folks,
**Katie Phang** and I are back with episode two of "**Breaking Bread** " and this one goes deep. We cover everything from therapy and parenting to the impossible balance between ambition and presence. If you've ever felt like you're running out of tools as a parent, partner, or person--this conversation is for you. It's vulnerable, reflective, and full of those moments that make you pause and say, "Yep, same."
* [00:01:07] Katie opens up about seeking a new therapist for her daughter and how the process prompted her own emotional reflection.
* [00:03:45] I talk about what therapy looks like for me now, including non-traditional forms like kayaking, mass, and forum meetings.
* [00:07:31] A conversation about parenting with structure and softness, and why both are necessary but hard to balance.
* [00:12:56] Katie shares a gut-punch moment when her daughter called her out--and how she responded with grace and accountability.
* [00:17:42] We close with a reflection on modeling emotional presence for our kids, and what it takes to stay in the room when things get hard.

I know your inbox is probably full, but this is important — and I hope you’ll read to the end.
We’re hours away from our end-of-quarter deadline, and I need to be honest: **we’re not where we need to be.**
We’re still short of our $30,000 goal — and what we raise tonight will determine how strong our start is as we look ahead to 2026.
**Here’s why this moment matters:** In 2026, Senator Jon Ossoff will be the only Democrat up for re-election in a state Donald Trump won. That makes Georgia ground zero — again — for control of the U.S. Senate.
**And if we lose this seat?** Republicans won’t just keep their Senate majority — they’ll expand it. They’ll have the power to steamroll everything: voting rights, Social Security, healthcare, reproductive freedom, and more.
We’ve fought back before here in Georgia and won — but only because we started organizing early.
**This time, we’re not waiting.**
This EOQ deadline is our moment to lay the groundwork. We’re talking about voter outreach, field operations, data tools — all the infrastructure we need to re-elect Senator Ossoff and keep Georgia blue in 2026.
But we’ll fall behind on any of that if we fall short tonight. Peter,

I think we can all agree, the past few weeks have been _a lot._ Trump and his allies are silencing free speech, suppressing votes, and trying to wear us down.

But Emerge women are showing up anyway. They’re running for office, defending their communities, and fighting for democracy. Even when it’s hard. Even when it’s risky.

Every year, I call our alums, whether they win or lose. I hear their stories, their gratitude, and the resilience that keeps them going. They tell me, “thank you for seeing me.” That simple recognition — seeing these women, believing in them, making space for them — is what fuels the next generation of leaders.

**Right now, we’re recruiting the next wave of women ready to step into office. Every alum we train today is one more fighter, one more leader, one more voice that can’t be ignored.**

We’ve trained over 6,500 women, with more than 1,200 currently in office. And every day, we’re building the network that keeps growing: women of the New American Majority stepping up to lead where it matters most.

[_**Here’s the truth: if we fall short of our September fundraising goal, we may have to scale back. That means fewer women trained, fewer leaders ready, and fewer victories at a moment when we need them most. Can you chip in $25 before midnight to help us train more women to run, win, and lead?**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/116293940/573086138/1143593133?refcode=BLU_EM_EMRG_2025-09-30_2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkVNUi8xLzgxMzIxIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjIyMDRiZDQxLTU0OWUtZjAxMS04ZTYxLTYwNDViZGVkOGJhNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=-kBGieW62F-fAOymn5k3YE-TdVt3XWo5pG_4uLwlZNM=)

Together, we can turn our exhaustion into energy, our anger into action, and our hope into recruiting and training the women leaders this country needs now more than ever.

Thank you for standing with us,

A’shanti F. Gholar

With all that in mind, it’s even more important for us to show our financial strength in this report. This is the most consequential Senate election of 2026, and if we win here, Democrats have the chance to take back the majority and stop the far-right’s extreme agenda. Meeting our fundraising goals is key to our chances of success in this toss-up race. But we have a long way to go to hit our end-of-quarter target, and we’re running out of time to get there.
